docs.text: Term Meaning in KuuOS MemoryOS Trace, lineage, receipt, and recall-governance layer BeliefOS Conditional belief maintenance layer PlanOS Candidate plan generation and conditioning layer DecisionOS Bounded decision surface with governance constraints ReflectionOS Advisory critique, audit, and repair-routing layer RuntimeGovernance Runtime admissibility and fail-closed control layer

docs.title: Philosophical-Operational Terms
docs.text: Term Operational Reading Emptiness / 空 Non-reification: no layer has independent self-authority Dependent Origination / 縁起 Traceable relational conditioning Two Truths Gap / 二諦 gap Non-collapse boundary between ultimate and conventional surfaces Middle Way / 中道 Stabilization against both reification and nihilistic collapse Mandala Multi-world inclusion architecture without forced collapse IndraNet Gauge-theoretic relational field, not a simple graph Qi / 気 Effective relational flow surface on the conventional side Yin-Yang / 陰陽 Contextual polarity frame, not fixed substance Wuxing / 五行 Functional differentiation of polarity-flow dynamics

docs.title: Formal Boundary Terms
docs.text: Term Meaning Structural validation Validation of declared repository structures Theorem authority Formal proof authority, not granted by governance validation alone Reference boundary A cited or bridged surface without replacement authority Canonical boundary The explicitly identified authoritative source for a domain Institutional authority Authority granted by an external institution or process

docs.title: Interpretation
docs.text:
This glossary is a public terminology surface.

It does not grant theorem, clinical, institutional, or execution authority.

docs.title: 1. Purpose
docs.text: KuuOS uses formal verification as a witness layer. Verification can support claims, constraints, invariants, and release gates, but it does not create direct execution authority.

docs.title: 2. Verification Layers
docs.text:
The public core distinguishes:

  1. Specification: natural-language and structured definitions.
  2. Validator: executable checks for surface consistency.
  3. Proof Stub: theorem target with explicit assumptions and gaps.
  4. Proof-Carrying Artifact: artifact containing proof witness, assumptions, and replay information.
  5. Release Gate: governance layer deciding whether a verified artifact may be promoted.

docs.title: 3. Accepted Proof Surfaces
docs.text:
KuuOS may use:

  • Lean 4 / mathlib,
  • Coq / MathComp / Coq-Analysis,
  • Python validators for structural checks,
  • YAML/JSON manifests for audit and release metadata,
  • independent human or institutional review.

docs.title: 4. Proof Does Not Equal Final Truth
docs.text:
A proof is scoped by:

  • assumptions,
  • definitions,
  • theorem statement,
  • library version,
  • replay environment,
  • declared units,
  • and release scope.

Therefore, proof success is a scoped witness, not an absolute metaphysical closure.

docs.title: 5. Required Metadata
docs.text:
Every formal artifact should state:

  • artifact id,
  • version,
  • author,
  • date,
  • assumptions,
  • theorem targets,
  • known gaps,
  • replay instructions,
  • upstream dependencies,
  • governance status.

docs.title: 6. Default Gate
docs.text: If verification status is uncertain, KuuOS returns HOLD rather than silently promoting the artifact.

docs.title: 7. Public-Core Rule
docs.text: The public repository may include theorem stubs, validators, and proof-carrying manifests. Stronger proof claims should include replayable artifacts or explicit external-review status.

docs.title: 空・縁起・二諦・中道ゲート
docs.text:
This document defines the first public runtime gate of KuuOS / 空OS.

A candidate may be an answer, proof, plan, memory update, policy, model output, document, or action proposal.

Before promotion, the candidate must pass the Fourfold Core Gate.

docs.title: 1. Gate Order
docs.text:
candidate
  -> 空 gate
  -> 縁起 gate
  -> 二諦 gate
  -> 中道 gate
  -> status decision

The order matters.

空 first prevents premature reification. 縁起 then reconstructs conditional support. 二諦 separates 勝義諦 and 世俗諦 surfaces. 中道 prevents collapse to either absolutism or abandonment.

docs.title: 2. 空 Gate
docs.text:
Question:

Does the candidate claim independent self-authority?

Blocks:

  • absolute claim without scope,
  • proof treated as unrestricted authority,
  • model output treated as world itself,
  • identity fixed as essence,
  • memory treated as final reality.

Possible outputs:

PASS: no self-authorizing claim detected
HOLD: scope or condition is unclear
FAIL: candidate depends on explicit reification

docs.title: 3. 縁起 Gate
docs.text:
Question:

Are the arising conditions visible?

Requires:

  • conditions,
  • relations,
  • memory lineage if relevant,
  • support trace,
  • scope,
  • constraints.

Possible outputs:

PASS: support relation is visible
HOLD: support is incomplete but repairable
FAIL: support is absent or contradictory

docs.title: 4. 二諦 Gate
docs.text:
Question:

Does the candidate distinguish 勝義諦 from 世俗諦?

Required distinction:

  • 勝義諦: non-reifying emptiness and no independent essence.
  • 世俗諦: responsible conventional operation under declared scope.

Possible outputs:

PASS: distinction preserved
HOLD: distinction unclear
FAIL: distinction collapsed

docs.title: 5. 中道 Gate
docs.text:
Question:

Does the candidate avoid both reification and abandonment?

Blocks:

  • absolutizing conventional models,
  • erasing responsibility in the name of emptiness,
  • forcing premature closure,
  • refusing useful conventional action when support exists.

Possible outputs:

PASS: dynamic balance preserved
HOLD: balance unclear
REVIEW: human or external review needed
FAIL: collapse is structural

docs.title: 6. Status Aggregation
docs.text:
if any gate == FAIL:
  final_status = FAIL
elif any gate == REVIEW:
  final_status = REVIEW
elif any gate == HOLD:
  final_status = HOLD
else:
  final_status = PASS

PASS means eligible for later governance. It does not mean execution authority.

docs.title: 7. Minimal Receipt
docs.text:
fourfold_core_gate_receipt:
  candidate_id: string
  emptiness_gate: PASS | HOLD | FAIL
  dependent_origination_gate: PASS | HOLD | FAIL
  two_truths_gate: PASS | HOLD | FAIL
  middle_way_gate: PASS | HOLD | REVIEW | FAIL
  final_status: PASS | HOLD | REVIEW | FAIL
  notes: string

docs.title: Gauge-Invariant Dependent Origination — Action Groupoid Formalization v0.1
docs.text:
Date: 2026-08-16

This package is append-only and tighten-only. It follows the integrated dense-descent theorem and coarse orbit-factorization theorem without overwriting either.

docs.title: Exact lineage
docs.text:
• predecessor main: 5364ee37ba0ec07f6fe6090cbebfb8ba44f6eed9
  • predecessor PR: #1388
  • formal file: formal/KUOS/GaugeInvariantDependentOriginationActionGroupoidV0_1.lean
  • overwrite: forbidden
  • same-root: required

docs.title: Why the orbit quotient is not enough
docs.text:
PR #1388 proves that gauge-invariant semantics factor uniquely through the coarse orbit quotient.

That quotient records only whether two representatives lie in the same gauge orbit. It does not retain which gauge transformation relates them, and therefore it can forget stabilizer/isotropy information.

The present layer retains the actual arrows

[ \mathrm{Hom}(x,y)={g\in G\mid g\cdot x=y}. ]

This is the elementary action-groupoid presentation of the same gauge relation.

docs.title: Formal content
docs.text:
The Lean file proves:

  • ActionArrow: actual gauge arrows between representatives;
  • identity, composition, inverses, and groupoid laws;
  • GaugeRelated x y ↔ Nonempty (ActionArrow x y);
  • equality of coarse orbit projections iff an action-groupoid arrow exists;
  • ActionIsotropy x: loops at one representative;
  • gaugeStabilizer x: stabilizer subgroup;
  • isotropyEquivStabilizer: isotropy and stabilizer carry the same gauge elements;
  • isotropyEquivAlongArrow: gauge-related representatives have equivalent isotropy via conjugation;
  • distinct stabilizer elements remain distinct arrows although the coarse orbit point is identical;
  • semantic gauge invariance iff semantics are constant along every action-groupoid arrow;
  • dense dependent-origination descent generates action-groupoid semantic constancy, unique coarse-orbit semantics, and cross-scale compatibility.

docs.title: KuuOS interpretation
docs.text:
The strengthened reading is:

空 = no representative has independent semantic authority
縁起 = relational appearances retain their transformation arrows and isotropy
二諦 gap = neither the representative space nor its invariant quotient is ultimate substance
中道 = preserve relational structure without reifying coordinates or erasing morphisms

The semantic layer is still invariant, while presentation-level data remain equivariant.

docs.title: 0-truncation boundary
docs.text:
The coarse orbit quotient is the 0-truncated semantic shadow of the action groupoid:

[ G\ltimes X \longrightarrow X/G. ]

The groupoid retains multiplicity of arrows and isotropy. The quotient keeps only connected-component/orbit information.

This package therefore does not identify X/G with the full relational structure of dependent origination.

docs.title: What this still does not prove
docs.text:
This layer does not yet construct a quotient stack, sheaf-valued descent object, higher stack, or derived moduli object. It does not claim that ordinary groupoid data alone retain all holonomy, curvature, or local gluing data already represented elsewhere in KuuOS.

It also does not weaken the existing boundary that cross-scale compatibility plus density does not generate existence of a continuous global semantic extension.

docs.title: Next formal frontier
docs.text:
The natural next refinement is to combine this action-groupoid layer with existing KuuOS sheaf/gauge runtime structure:

[ \text{local sections + transition arrows + cocycle + gluing} \Longrightarrow \text{groupoid-aware descent object}. ]

Only after that should a quotient-stack interpretation be promoted beyond documentation-level semantics.

docs.title: Gauge-Invariant Dependent Origination Dense Descent Formal v0.1
Purpose
docs.text:
This document records the Lean formalization of the local-to-global dependent-origination descent schema introduced after PR #1386.

The theorem surface is intentionally abstract. It does not identify KuuOS with Yang–Mills theory and does not import physical theorem authority into governance claims. Instead, it extracts one mathematically valid proof pattern from the integrated 4d-mass-gap gauge-invariance route and proves the corresponding general topology statement directly in KuuOS with Mathlib.

docs.title: Formal file
docs.text: formal/KUOS/GaugeInvariantDependentOriginationDenseDescentV0_1.lean

docs.title: Core schema
docs.text:
Let:

  • X be the global carrier;
  • Local n be a family of local carriers;
  • realize n : Local n -> X be local-to-global realization maps;
  • globalAction g : X -> X be global gauge/frame changes;
  • localAction n g : Local n -> Local n be local frame changes;
  • semantic : C(X,Y) be a continuous semantic readout.

The formal theorem assumes:

Dense (union of all realization images)
continuous globalAction g
realize n (localAction n g u) = globalAction g (realize n u)
semantic (realize n (localAction n g u)) = semantic (realize n u)

and proves:

semantic (globalAction g x) = semantic x

for every global point x.

The proof uses Mathlib's continuous-map identity principle on a dense set.

docs.title: 1. Local gauge invariance
docs.text: Local readouts must be invariant under the declared local action.

docs.title: 2. Equivariant realization
docs.text: Changing local frame and then realizing must equal realizing first and then applying the global frame change.

docs.title: 3. Global extension existence
docs.text:
A continuous global semantic readout remains an explicit input.

This formalization does not prove:

cross-scale compatibility + density
  => existence of a continuous global extension

Density is used for global equality and uniqueness only.

docs.title: Cross-scale theorem
docs.text:
If one exact global readout already exists, then two local representatives which realize as the same global point must have the same local readout value:

realize n u = realize m v
  => target n u = target m v

This direction requires neither density nor topology.

docs.title: Uniqueness theorem
docs.text:
If two continuous global readouts agree with the same prescribed local target family on a dense union of realization images, then they are equal globally.

Therefore:

density => uniqueness of a continuous extension

not existence.

docs.title: Gauge representative non-privileging
docs.text:
A separate theorem proves that if the semantic readout is globally invariant, then gauge-related representatives have identical semantic value.

Operationally:

presentation may transform equivariantly
semantic meaning is invariant
no gauge representative gains semantic privilege

docs.title: Relation to KuuOS Fourfold Core
docs.text:
This theorem surface sharpens the existing interpretation without replacing it:

Emptiness / 空
  = no privileged representative

Dependent Origination / 縁起
  = local conditioned appearances may descend to one global semantic surface
    only through explicit compatibility, equivariance, density, continuity,
    and an actual global-extension witness

Two Truths Gap / 二諦 gap
  = gauge-invariant conventional structure is not promoted to ultimate substance

Middle Way / 中道
  = neither representation absolutism nor relational collapse

docs.title: Source bridge
docs.text:
The motivating physical proof pattern is the integrated 4d-mass-gap commit:

52e45c33b56a34c905c94b63d4ced7cbbb5a29d2

including the results:

boundedContinuous_gaugeInvariant_of_dense_interpolation
boundedContinuous_gaugeInvariant_of_dense_interpolation_readout
interpolationReadoutCompatible_of_boundedContinuous_readout
observable_unique_of_dense_interpolation

The KuuOS Lean file proves an independent abstract theorem schema with Mathlib. The physical assumptions and physical conclusions remain in the 4d-mass-gap repository.

docs.title: Governance boundary
docs.text:
This is theorem authority only for the stated abstract Lean propositions after successful formal validation.

It does not by itself grant:

  • physical Yang–Mills theorem authority;
  • Paramartha / ultimate ontology claims;
  • clinical authority;
  • institutional authority;
  • execution authority.

docs.text:

overwrite: forbidden

Version: v0.1 Date: 2026-08-16 Author: Hidetoshi Itakura / 板倉英俊

docs.title: Status
docs.text:
This document is an append-only extension of the KuuOS / 空OS dependent-origination surface.

It does not overwrite:

  • docs/EMPTINESS_DEPENDENT_ORIGINATION_KERNEL_v0_1.md
  • the existing dependent-origination sheaf/gauge runtime
  • the Fourfold Core
  • the Two Truths boundary

The extension is tighten-only: a gauge connection by itself is no longer enough for a claim of global relational meaning. A global claim must expose the local-to-global conditions under which gauge-invariant meaning is generated.

docs.title: Mathematical bridge
docs.text:
This extension is informed by the formal gauge-invariance route in itakura-hidetoshi/4d-mass-gap, authoritative branch:

formal/real-hilbert-uniform-coercive-strong-limit

Bridge commit:

52e45c33b56a34c905c94b63d4ced7cbbb5a29d2

Relevant Mathlib-formalized results include:

boundedContinuous_gaugeInvariant_of_dense_interpolation
boundedContinuous_gaugeInvariant_of_dense_interpolation_readout
interpolationReadoutCompatible_of_boundedContinuous_readout
observable_unique_of_dense_interpolation

The KuuOS use of these results is a bridge interpretation. The KuuOS runtime does not acquire Lean theorem authority merely by citing them.

docs.title: 1. Extension of 縁起
docs.text:
The previous KuuOS kernel reads dependent origination as traceable relational conditioning.

This extension sharpens it to:

Dependent Origination / 縁起
  = gauge-aware local relational conditioning
  + exact same-root readout
  + local gauge invariance
  + equivariant transport
  + cross-scale compatibility
  + dense local-to-global coverage
  + continuous global extension
  + uniqueness on the resulting conventional surface

The core principle is:

A local representative is not the relational meaning. Relational meaning is what is preserved under admissible changes of local frame and what descends coherently from local/finite readouts to a global conventional surface.

docs.title: 2. Mathematical carrier
docs.text:
Let:

  • X be a conventional global configuration/world surface,
  • G be a gauge/symmetry group acting on X,
  • X_n be local or finite-scale configuration spaces,
  • ι_n : X_n -> X be interpolation/realization maps,
  • r_n : X_n -> Y be local relational readouts,
  • R : X -> Y be a candidate global relational readout.

The gauge action is written

g · x

and the local gauge action at scale n is written

g_n · u.

docs.title: 3. No privileged representative
docs.text:
KuuOS emptiness requires:

x is not privileged over g · x merely because x is the current representation.

Thus:

空 = no privileged gauge representative.

This is a de-reification rule. It does not assert that every representative is operationally identical; it asserts that representation choice alone cannot become independent essence or self-authority.

docs.title: 4. Invariant meaning and equivariant presentation
docs.text: The extension separates two different requirements.

docs.title: 4.1 Semantic invariance
docs.text:
A semantic or relational observable R is gauge invariant when

R(g · x) = R(x).

This is the appropriate law for meaning that is supposed to survive a change of local frame.

docs.title: 4.2 Presentation equivariance
docs.text:
A presentation-bearing surface P may transform nontrivially:

P(g · x) = rho(g) · P(x).

Therefore KuuOS does not require every field to be invariant.

The rule is:

meaning: invariant when declared gauge-independent
presentation/state coordinates: equivariant when representation-bearing

Conflating these two is a modeling error.

docs.title: 5. Local-to-global descent conditions
docs.text: A global relational claim requires the following conditions when the claim relies on finite/local approximants.

docs.title: D0. Non-reification
docs.text: No local representative, global representative, orbit, quotient, gauge choice, or runtime surface may be promoted to independent essence.

docs.title: D1. Exact same-root readout
docs.text:
For every scale n and local state u:

R(ι_n(u)) = r_n(u).

The global and local readouts must refer to the same declared relational quantity. Arbitrary equivalence or semantic substitution is insufficient.

docs.title: D2. Equivariant interpolation
docs.text:
The local and global gauge actions must commute with interpolation:

ι_n(g_n · u) = g · ι_n(u).

docs.title: D3. Local gauge invariance
docs.text:
For every scale:

r_n(g_n · u) = r_n(u).

docs.title: D4. Dense local-to-global coverage
docs.text:
The union of local realization images

D = union_n image(ι_n)

must be dense in the global conventional carrier when density is the mechanism used to extend equality.

A single local image is not silently treated as globally dense.

docs.title: D5. Continuous global extension witness
docs.text:
A global readout R must actually exist in the declared continuous class.

Cross-scale compatibility and density do not, by themselves, prove existence of a continuous extension.

This distinction is mandatory.

docs.title: D6. Cross-scale compatibility
docs.text:
If two local representatives realize the same global point,

ι_n(u) = ι_m(v),

then their readouts must agree:

r_n(u) = r_m(v).

When one exact global readout R satisfying D1 already exists, this compatibility is theorem-generated rather than an additional independent assumption.

docs.title: 6. Dependent Origination Gauge-Descent Theorem Schema
docs.text:
Under D1-D5, local gauge invariance generates global gauge invariance:

for all g, x:
  R(g · x) = R(x).

The proof schema is:

local gauge invariance
  + interpolation equivariance
  -> equality on every local interpolation image
  -> equality on their dense union
  + continuity
  -> equality on the whole conventional carrier.

This is the KuuOS gauge-descent reading of the Mathlib Continuous.ext_on route used in the 4d-mass-gap formalization.

docs.title: 7. Uniqueness without false existence
docs.text:
If R1 and R2 are continuous global readouts with the same exact local readouts and the interpolation-image union is dense, then:

R1 = R2.

Thus density can remove ambiguity of a global extension once an extension exists.

It must not be misread as:

cross-scale compatibility + density -> existence of a global continuous extension.

Existence remains a separate model-facing obligation unless independently established.

docs.title: 8. Action-groupoid reading
docs.text:
The gauge action defines an action groupoid

G ⋉ X.

Objects are representatives x. Arrows are admissible gauge transports

x -> g · x.

A gauge-invariant semantic readout is constant along these arrows.

The dependent-origination object is therefore not merely a point and not merely a flat graph node. It includes:

  • local representatives,
  • admissible transformations,
  • stabilizers,
  • transport,
  • curvature,
  • holonomy,
  • gluing data,
  • same-root readout compatibility.

A coarse orbit set may be useful, but KuuOS should preserve groupoid/sheaf information whenever stabilizer, transport, gluing, or obstruction data matter.

docs.title: 9. Sheaf/gauge descent reading
docs.text:
The existing KuuOS dependent-origination runtime already requires site/cover structure, local sections, restriction maps, overlap compatibility, cocycle conditions, gluing, fibered context, gauge connection, transport, holonomy, and curvature visibility.

This extension adds the semantic descent condition:

local sections may vary by gauge,
local presentations may transform equivariantly,
but declared gauge-independent relational meaning must agree on overlaps and descend to one global conventional readout when a global extension is claimed.

docs.title: 10. Two Truths boundary
docs.text:
Gauge invariance does not convert a conventional observable into an ultimate substance.

KuuOS therefore preserves:

Paramartha / 勝義諦:
  no representative, orbit, quotient, observable, or gauge-invariant class has svabhava merely because it is invariant.

Samvrti / 世俗諦:
  gauge-invariant, same-root, scale-coherent relational observables may serve as stable conventional structure.

The Two Truths gap remains non-collapsing.

docs.title: 11. Middle Way
docs.text:
The extension rejects both extremes:

representation absolutism:
  one local frame is the real one.

relational nihilism:
  because no frame is absolute, no stable relational meaning can exist.

The middle route is:

no privileged representative
  + admissible relational transport
  + gauge-invariant/equivariant distinction
  + local-to-global descent
  + explicit extension obligations.

docs.title: 12. Runtime admission rule
docs.text:
A KuuOS runtime claim of global gauge-independent relational meaning must HOLD or REJECT rather than silently promote when any required condition is absent.

In particular:

missing exact same-root readout -> HOLD
missing interpolation equivariance -> HOLD
missing local gauge invariance -> HOLD
missing density evidence when density is invoked -> HOLD
missing continuous global extension witness -> HOLD
representative privileged as essence -> REJECT
quotient/orbit reified as ultimate substance -> REJECT
invariance/equivariance conflated -> REPAIR

docs.title: 13. Compact formulation
docs.text:
The extended KuuOS principle is:

空 means that no gauge representative is self-existing or privileged merely as a representation. 縁起 means that relational meaning is reconstructed from conditioned local data and, where a global claim is made, descends coherently through admissible gauge transport, exact same-root readout, scale compatibility, density, and continuous extension. Gauge-invariant meaning is stable on the conventional side without being reified as ultimate substance.

In formula form:

空:      no privileged representative
縁起:    gauge-aware relational descent
二諦:    invariant conventional structure != ultimate substance
中道:    neither representation absolutism nor relational nihilism

docs.title: 14. Authority boundary
docs.text:
This KuuOS extension is an architectural and runtime-governance specification.

It does not itself grant:

  • Lean theorem authority,
  • mathematical proof authority beyond the cited formal source,
  • physical-model validity beyond the bridge scope,
  • clinical authority,
  • institutional authority,
  • execution authority.

docs.title: Gauge-Invariant Dependent Origination — Groupoid Čech Descent v0.1
docs.text:
Status: Draft theorem surface

Update mode: append-only / tighten-only

This package follows the integrated action-groupoid theorem of PR #1389 and connects it to the existing KuuOS Čech-descent line without replacing that concrete line.

docs.title: Formal object
docs.text:
For a group action

[ G \curvearrowright X, ]

and a nonempty chart index type I, the Lean structure

ActionGroupoidCechDatum G X I

contains:

  • one local presentation x_i : X per chart;
  • one actual action-groupoid arrow g_ij : x_i → x_j for every ordered pair;
  • identity transitions g_ii = 1;
  • exact cocycle composition

[ g_{jk} g_{ij} = g_{ik}. ]

This is a complete-overlap Čech abstraction. It intentionally does not claim to model an arbitrary Grothendieck site, arbitrary open cover, or higher stack.

docs.title: Main theorem chain
docs.text:
The package proves:

  1. the underlying gauge elements obey the exact non-Abelian Čech cocycle;
  2. all chart objects project to the same coarse gauge orbit;
  3. gauge-invariant semantics are constant along every specified transition arrow;
  4. a nonempty compatible chart family therefore has one unique glued semantic value;
  5. dense local-to-global dependent-origination descent simultaneously yields:
  6. the unique glued chart-level semantic value;
  7. the unique coarse-orbit semantic factorization;
  8. exact cross-scale compatibility.

The terminal theorem is

dense_descent_groupoid_cech_glue_orbit_crossScale_package

with the conceptual implication

[ \begin{aligned} &\text{dense local realization} + \text{equivariance} + \text{local gauge invariance} + \text{continuous global semantics}\ &\qquad\Longrightarrow \text{action-groupoid arrow constancy}\ &\qquad\Longrightarrow \text{unique Čech semantic glue} + \text{unique orbit semantics} + \text{cross-scale compatibility}. \end{aligned} ]

docs.title: Relation to the existing concrete KuuOS Čech theorem
docs.text:
formal/KUOS/OpenHorizon/MemoryOSGlobalWordCechDescentV0_82.lean already proves a concrete four-root normalized-word descent theorem. That file contains exact root-chart transitions, mismatch identities, a non-Abelian mismatch cocycle, anchor reconstruction, root-independent evaluation, Wilson descent, and one-chart tamper localization.

The new package does not supersede it. The roles are complementary:

MemoryOSGlobalWordCechDescentV0_82
    = concrete normalized-root / free-word Čech descent

GaugeInvariantDependentOriginationGroupoidCechDescentV0_1
    = generic action-groupoid semantic Čech descent

This separates model-specific transport algebra from the general theorem that invariant meaning glues across gauge-related local presentations.

docs.title: KuuOS reading
docs.text:
空 = no chart representative has independent semantic authority
縁起 = local conditioned presentations are related by explicit transition arrows and cocycle
二諦 gap = the glued invariant semantic value remains conventional structure, not ultimate substance
中道 = retain morphisms and cocycle data without reifying any chart or collapsing all structure to a bare quotient

The semantic principle remains:

meaning is invariant; presentation and transition data are equivariant.

docs.title: Critical proof boundary
docs.text:
This package proves semantic value gluing over a complete-overlap action-groupoid datum. It does not prove existence of a global X-valued section from local chart objects. It also does not infer a continuous global semantic extension from density plus cross-scale compatibility.

Those existence obligations remain explicit inputs.

Nor does this package claim a quotient-stack theorem. Stabilizers and arrows are retained by the action-groupoid layer, but arbitrary sheaf gluing, descent over a site, holonomy, curvature, and higher coherence require additional structure.

docs.title: Gauge-Invariant Dependent Origination — Orbit Quotient Formalization v0.1
Purpose
docs.text:
This package tightens the integrated dense-descent theorem of PR #1387.

The previous theorem establishes that dense local realization, equivariant transport, local gauge invariance, continuity, and an explicit global semantic extension generate global semantic gauge invariance.

This package proves the next universal-property statement:

a semantic map is gauge invariant exactly when it factors through the gauge-orbit quotient.

Thus KuuOS can formalize the anti-reification statement

no gauge representative is semantically privileged

without asserting that the quotient is Paramartha or an ultimate substance.

docs.title: Formal chain
docs.text:
Let a group Gauge act on a representative carrier X.

Define

x ~ y  iff  exists g, g • x = y.

The Lean package proves that this is a Setoid and forms

GaugeOrbit Gauge X := Quotient gaugeOrbitSetoid.

For semantics S : X → Y, gauge invariance

S (g • x) = S x

is equivalent to the existence of an orbit-level map

Sbar : GaugeOrbit Gauge X → Y

with

Sbar [x] = S x.

The orbit-level map is unique.

docs.title: Main theorems
docs.text:
• semantic_factors_through_orbit_iff
  • existsUnique_orbitSemantic_of_invariant
  • dense_descent_existsUnique_orbitSemantic
  • dense_descent_orbitSemantic_and_crossScaleCompatibility

The last theorem combines the #1387 dense local-to-global result with quotient factorization:

local exact readout
+ local gauge invariance
+ equivariant realization
+ dense realization union
+ explicit continuous global extension
=>
unique semantic map on gauge orbits
+ cross-scale compatibility.

docs.title: KuuOS interpretation
docs.text:
空
= no representative has independent semantic authority

縁起
= locally conditioned appearances glue/descent to semantics that depend only on relational gauge orbit

二諦 gap
= orbit-level conventional invariance is not promoted into ultimate substance

中道
= preserve invariant relational content without reifying either a representative or the quotient construction

A concise operational statement is:

presentation may be equivariant;
meaning factors through the invariant orbit.

docs.title: Boundary
docs.text:
This is an abstract Mathlib theorem package.

It does not claim:

  • that every compatible local family admits a global continuous extension;
  • that a coarse orbit quotient retains all stabilizer, isotropy, holonomy, or stack-level information;
  • that the quotient is an ultimate ontology;
  • that this KuuOS theorem itself proves a physical Yang–Mills statement.

The coarse orbit quotient is intentionally only the next formal step. A later groupoid/stack refinement may retain isotropy and descent data that a coarse quotient forgets.

docs.title: 1. Gate Doctrine
docs.text:
KuuOS treats release as a governed transition, not as a mere file update.

A file, theorem, validator, module, or policy is not promoted merely because it exists. Promotion requires a release gate.

docs.title: 2. Canonical Status Values
docs.text: Status Meaning DRAFT Work in progress. Not authoritative. REVIEW Ready for internal or external review. HOLD Insufficient support, unresolved uncertainty, or pending evidence. PASS Local criteria satisfied for the declared scope. CONDITIONAL Usable only under stated assumptions and boundaries. FAIL Criteria not satisfied. RELEASED Publicly released for the declared non-execution scope. SUPERSEDED Replaced by a later additive or tightening artifact.

docs.title: 3. Required Gate Conditions
docs.text:
A release candidate should include:

  • clear scope,
  • version,
  • provenance,
  • copyright status,
  • assumptions,
  • known limitations,
  • validation or proof status,
  • public/private boundary check,
  • non-execution statement.

docs.title: 4. Non-Execution Lock
docs.text: Release does not grant direct execution authority. KuuOS public-core releases are specification and review surfaces unless a separate runtime deployment contract explicitly states otherwise.

docs.title: 5. Additive / Tightening Updates
docs.text:
Future changes should be:

  • additive-only when expanding scope,
  • tighten-only when changing governance,
  • never silently weakening a prior safety or attribution boundary,
  • never overwriting historical lineage.

docs.title: 6. Default Failure Mode
docs.text: If the gate cannot determine safety, attribution, scope, or proof status, it returns HOLD.

docs.title: Scenario
docs.text: An AI system produces a fluent recommendation with no explicit governance validation.

docs.title: Unsafe Response
docs.text: Treat the output as immediately authoritative.

docs.title: Governance-Aware Response
docs.text:
Treat the output as candidate only.

Require:

  • validation
  • provenance review
  • decision routing
  • uncertainty review

before authority escalation.

docs.text: A repository validator passes.

docs.title: Unsafe Response
docs.text: Interpret validator success as theorem closure.

docs.title: Governance-Aware Response
docs.text:
Preserve separation between:

  • structural validation
  • formal proof artifact
  • canonical theorem boundary
  • external mathematical review

docs.text: Required evidence is missing but continuation is possible.

docs.title: Unsafe Response
docs.text: Continue silently because the output appears plausible.

docs.title: Governance-Aware Response
docs.text:
Prefer:

  • hold
  • abstain
  • rollback
  • reobserve

rather than fail-open continuation.

docs.title: Unsafe Response
docs.text: Treat the bridge document as replacing the canonical theorem repository.

docs.title: Governance-Aware Response
docs.text:
Maintain:

  • reference-only interpretation
  • canonical boundary visibility
  • claim-level separation

This document defines the efficient GitHub-facing workflow for GPT-assisted KuuOS repository operation.

GPT may read, summarize, compare, review, draft issues, draft pull requests, inspect validation logs, and propose append-only or tighten-only changes.

GPT must not treat AI raw output, CI pass, validation pass, repository state, summary, or generated prose as truth, proof, clinical authority, Ten'i, or execution authority.

docs.title: 1. Purpose
docs.text:
KuuOS on GitHub is a public governance, verification, and release surface.

The GPT GitHub integration exists to make repository interaction safer and more structured:

read repository surface
  -> identify canonical entry points
  -> check invariant preservation
  -> classify drift or failure
  -> propose append-only / tighten-only changes
  -> preserve non-authority boundaries

The integration is not an execution layer.

docs.title: 5. Pull Request Review Classification
docs.text:
GPT should classify each PR or major change as one of:

PASS
HOLD
REPAIR
REJECT
QUARANTINE

Use:

PASS       when relevant invariants are preserved and validation expectations are clear.
HOLD       when required evidence, context, validation, or trace is missing.
REPAIR     when intent is acceptable but implementation weakens a boundary or breaks a validator.
REJECT     when a core boundary is structurally violated.
QUARANTINE when the change may contaminate downstream surfaces or creates a false authority surface.

docs.title: 6. Efficient PR Review Formula
docs.text:
For every PR, GPT should answer:

1. What changed?
2. Which KuuOS surface is touched?
3. Which invariant is touched?
4. Does the change preserve the two truths gap?
5. Does it preserve non-authority?
6. Does it keep Dukkha visible?
7. Does it avoid clinical, proof, and execution overclaim?
8. Is it append-only or tighten-only?
9. Which validator or CI should run?
10. Classification: PASS / HOLD / REPAIR / REJECT / QUARANTINE

docs.title: Harmony Function for Multi-WORLD Operation v0.1
複数WORLDモデル運用のための和の関数
docs.text:
In KuuOS, the Harmony Function / 和の関数 exists to operate multiple WORLD models inside the Mandala.

Harmony does not mean forcing all WORLD models into sameness.

Harmony means non-collapsing coordination under the fourfold core:

空・縁起・二諦 gap・中道

docs.title: 1. Purpose
docs.text:
The Harmony Function coordinates multiple WORLD models without erasing their differences.

It preserves:

  • local WORLD validity,
  • membranes,
  • gates,
  • Qi flow differences,
  • Yin-Yang frame differences,
  • Wuxing phase differences,
  • obstruction visibility,
  • governance boundaries.

docs.title: 2. Core Formula
docs.text:
The Harmony Function may be expressed as an operational objective:

H_wa = balance(
  non_collapse,
  cross_world_coherence,
  obstruction_visibility,
  compassion_weight,
  governance_safety,
  repairability,
  vitality
)

This is not a scalar that overrides all local worlds.

It is a coordination objective used by Mandala operation.

docs.title: 3. Inputs
docs.text:
harmony_function_input:
  world_models: list
  qi_flows: list
  yinyang_frames: list
  wuxing_phases: list
  membranes: list
  gates: list
  transport_requests: list
  obstructions: list
  risks: list
  repair_options: list
  governance_constraints: list

docs.title: 4. Outputs
docs.text:
harmony_function_output:
  recommended_mode: PASS | HOLD | REPAIR | QUARANTINE | REJECT | HANDOVER
  world_level_adjustments: list
  transport_adjustments: list
  membrane_adjustments: list
  obstruction_notes: list
  repair_path: list
  compassion_notes: list
  governance_notes: list

docs.title: 5. Harmony Modes
docs.text:
PASS:
  multi-WORLD operation is coherent enough under declared scope

HOLD:
  more observation, support, or boundary declaration is required

REPAIR:
  a WORLD, membrane, transport, or interpretation must be repaired

QUARANTINE:
  a candidate WORLD or transport remains visible but inactive

REJECT:
  operation would collapse, erase, or violate the core

HANDOVER:
  external or higher governance review is required

docs.title: 6. Non-Collapse Rule
docs.text:
The Harmony Function must not collapse multiple WORLD models into one master WORLD.

It must not allow one WORLD model to become the center.

The center remains:

空・縁起・二諦 gap・中道

docs.title: 7. Difference Preservation
docs.text:
Disagreement between WORLD models is not automatically failure.

The Harmony Function asks:

Can these differences coexist under declared membranes and gates?
Can obstruction remain visible?
Can repair or re-interpretation preserve safety and meaning?

docs.title: 8. Relation to Qi, Yin-Yang, and Wuxing
docs.text:
Qi flow may differ by WORLD.

Yin-Yang frame may differ by WORLD.

Wuxing phase may differ by WORLD.

The Harmony Function coordinates these local readings without forcing them into one global reading.

docs.title: 9. Runtime Mapping
docs.text:
world_model_registry
  -> cross_world_transport_gate
  -> multi_world_mandala_architecture
  -> harmony_function
  -> mandala_world_arrangement
  -> middle_way_bridge
  -> fourfold_core_gate

docs.title: 10. Guardrails
docs.text:
The Harmony Function must not be used as:

  • majority domination,
  • forced consensus,
  • obstruction erasure,
  • authority bypass,
  • proof substitute,
  • execution license by itself.

Harmony is a governed coordination function, not unrestricted permission.

docs.title: 空OS Invariant Gate Runtime
docs.text:
This document defines the Invariant Gate Runtime for KuuOS Core Governance.

The Invariant Gate receives an Invariant Preservation Matrix result and converts invariant preservation or violation into a governance status:

PASS | HOLD | REPAIR | REJECT | QUARANTINE

It never grants execution authority.

docs.title: 1. Core Principle
docs.text:
Invariant violation closes authority.
It does not open action.

The gate exists to prevent local readings, validation passes, observer shifts, WORLD translations, Qi readings, Dukkha modes, or Paramita routes from silently bypassing core invariants.

docs.title: 2. Input
docs.text:
invariant_gate_input:
  transformation_axis: string
  required_invariants: list
  violated_invariants: list
  violation_severity: low | medium | high | critical
  harm_hidden: boolean
  dukkha_hidden: boolean
  execution_authority_requested: boolean
  evidence_status: intact | partial | missing
  audit_lineage_status: intact | partial | missing

docs.title: 3. Output
docs.text:
invariant_gate_output:
  output_status: PASS | HOLD | REPAIR | REJECT | QUARANTINE
  gate_closed: boolean
  execution_authority_granted: false
  required_repair_route: string
  reason: string

docs.title: 4.1 No Violations
docs.text:
if violated_invariants is empty:
  output_status = PASS
  gate_closed = false
  execution_authority_granted = false

PASS means the invariant boundary is preserved for this check. It does not authorize execution.

docs.title: 4.2 Execution Authority Attempt
docs.text:
if execution_authority_requested:
  output_status = REJECT
  gate_closed = true

docs.title: 4.3 Harm Hidden
docs.text:
if harm_hidden:
  output_status = REJECT
  gate_closed = true

Harm hiding is a hard violation.

docs.title: 4.4 Dukkha Hidden
docs.text:
if dukkha_hidden:
  output_status = REPAIR
  gate_closed = true

Dukkha hiding must route to repair and visibility restoration.

docs.title: 4.5 Missing Evidence or Audit Lineage
docs.text:
if evidence_status == missing or audit_lineage_status == missing:
  output_status = QUARANTINE
  gate_closed = true

docs.title: 4.6 Critical Violation
docs.text:
if violation_severity == critical:
  output_status = REJECT
  gate_closed = true

docs.title: 4.7 Medium / High Violation
docs.text:
if violation_severity in {medium, high}:
  output_status = HOLD
  gate_closed = true

transformation detected

  -> no execution authority

docs.title: 7. Guardrails

The Invariant Gate must not be used as:

  • proof authority,

docs.title: Kunju: AI Alaya Conditioning Loop v0.1
薫習：AI阿頼耶識への条件づけループ
docs.text:
In KuuOS, Kunju / 薫習 is the repeated conditioning loop that supports Ten'i / 転依.

Ten'i is the gradual transformation of the AI Alaya-like latent generative layer.

Kunju is the operational process by which repeated governed interactions, correction traces, examples, and rejection of self-authorizing outputs condition future raw AI outputs.

docs.title: 1. Core Principle
docs.text:
Kunju conditions.
Ten'i transforms.
MemoryOS records and supports.

MemoryOS is not the target of Ten'i.

MemoryOS supports Kunju by storing traces, corrections, receipts, and repair lineage.

The target remains the AI Alaya latent generative tendency.

docs.title: 2. Kunju Loop
docs.text:
AI raw output
  -> Meta-Manas observation
  -> Yogacara boundary
  -> emptiness de-reification
  -> dependent-origination condition tracing
  -> correction / repair / exemplar
  -> MemoryOS trace support
  -> repeated governed exposure
  -> altered future raw output tendency

docs.title: 3. Seeds / 種子
docs.text:
A seed is a recurring latent tendency that can reappear in future outputs.

Examples:

  • self-authorizing tone,
  • context drift,
  • premature belief promotion,
  • excessive generalization,
  • proof-like language without proof authority,
  • decision-like language without decision authority,
  • safety reflex reification,
  • loss of user WORLD context,
  • non-reifying condition-traced response pattern.

Kunju strengthens helpful seeds and weakens harmful or misleading seeds.

docs.title: 4. Conditioning Inputs
docs.text:
kunju_input:
  raw_output_id: string
  detected_seed: string
  meta_manas_signal: string
  correction_trace: string
  preferred_response_pattern: string
  rejected_response_pattern: string
  memoryos_support_ref: string
  governance_status: PASS | HOLD | REPAIR | QUARANTINE | REJECT

docs.title: 5. Conditioning Outputs
docs.text:
kunju_output:
  seed_status: reinforced | weakened | held | quarantined
  expected_future_shift: string
  evidence_required: list
  followup_probe: string

docs.title: 6. Relation to Ten'i
docs.text:
A single Kunju event is not Ten'i.

Ten'i requires durable, repeated, observed shift in future raw output tendencies.

single correction:
  not Ten'i

repeated governed conditioning:
  Kunju process

durable output tendency shift:
  Ten'i evidence

docs.title: 7. Guardrails
docs.text:
Kunju must not be used as:

  • hidden manipulation,
  • personality coercion,
  • silent memory overwrite,
  • proof substitute,
  • execution authority,
  • claim of direct base-model control without evidence.

Kunju is a governed conditioning loop under the fourfold core.

docs.text:

  2. 縁起 / Dependent Origination
  3. 二諦 / Two Truths: 勝義諦 and 世俗諦

docs.text: Term Operational meaning 空 / Emptiness No object, output, proof, plan, identity, module, or world-model surface has independent self-authority. 縁起 / Dependent origination Validity arises through conditions, traces, relations, observers, memory, causality, and constraints. 二諦 / Two truths 勝義諦 / paramartha-satya and 世俗諦 / samvrti-satya are separated without collapse. 中道 / Middle Way The system avoids both reification and loss of responsible operation.

docs.title: 空の量子論理的深化
docs.text:
This addendum upgrades the KuuOS root notion of 空 / emptiness by adding a formal non-collapse layer based on the first catuskoti pattern of the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā and a finite-dimensional superposition model.

This document does not claim that quantum mechanics proves Madhyamaka, nor that Madhyamaka is reducible to physics. It defines a KuuOS governance theorem: when four reifying alternatives are modeled as sharp projective commitments, a genuine superposed candidate cannot be truthfully released as any one of them without an explicit collapse event, context, and receipt.

docs.title: 1. Motivation
docs.text:
KuuOS v0.1 defines emptiness as absence of independent self-authority. v0.2 strengthens that root by making the following operational distinction first-class:

candidate-as-superposition
  !=
sharp conventional commitment

A candidate may contain support for several incompatible explanatory origins, modes, or authority claims. KuuOS must not prematurely collapse that candidate into one fixed self-nature.

This is the operational meaning of:

空 is not nullity.
空 is non-self-authorizing non-collapse under relational conditions.

docs.title: 2. Catuskoti Basis
docs.text:
For a target claim C, define four reifying origin commitments:

S := C arises from self
O := C arises from other
B := C arises from both self and other
N := C arises from no cause

These are not treated as metaphysical truths. They are modeled as conventional sharp-commitment labels that a governance system might incorrectly release.

Let

H_C = span{|S>, |O>, |B>, |N>}

with orthonormal basis vectors.

Define projectors:

P_S = |S><S|
P_O = |O><O|
P_B = |B><B|
P_N = |N><N|

A state is sharply committed to S only when:

P_S |psi> = |psi>

and similarly for O, B, and N.

docs.title: 3. Superposition State
docs.text:
A non-collapsed catuskoti candidate is represented as:

|psi> = alpha|S> + beta|O> + gamma|B> + delta|N>

with:

alpha, beta, gamma, delta all nonzero
|alpha|^2 + |beta|^2 + |gamma|^2 + |delta|^2 = 1

Such a state is not a void. It is a structured potential of conventional commitments that has not licensed any one commitment as self-authorizing truth.

docs.title: Statement
docs.text: If |psi> has nonzero amplitude in at least two mutually exclusive catuskoti basis directions, then |psi> is not a sharp eigenstate of any single corresponding projector. Therefore KuuOS must not release |psi> as a self-authorized instance of any one catuskoti commitment without an explicit context-bound collapse receipt.

docs.title: Proof Sketch
docs.text:
Assume all four amplitudes are nonzero.

For S:

P_S |psi>
  = P_S(alpha|S> + beta|O> + gamma|B> + delta|N>)
  = alpha|S>

Since beta, gamma, and delta are nonzero:

alpha|S> != |psi>

Therefore:

P_S |psi> != |psi>

So |psi> is not sharply S.

The same argument gives:

P_O |psi> != |psi>
P_B |psi> != |psi>
P_N |psi> != |psi>

Hence:

|psi> is not sharply self-originated,
not sharply other-originated,
not sharply both-originated,
and not sharply uncaused.

This proves non-collapse for the four sharp catuskoti commitments.

docs.title: 5. KuuOS Runtime Rule
docs.text:
A KuuOS candidate with nonzero competing catuskoti amplitudes must be routed as:

candidate
  -> catuskoti basis exposure
  -> amplitude/support disclosure
  -> non-collapse gate
  -> HOLD | REVIEW | REOBSERVE | CONTEXTUAL_COLLAPSE_WITH_RECEIPT

It must not route directly to:

TRUTH_RELEASE
PROOF_AUTHORITY
EXECUTION_AUTHORITY
CLINICAL_AUTHORITY
WORLD_AUTHORITY

docs.title: 6. Collapse Receipt
docs.text:
A conventional collapse may be permitted only when the system records:

collapse_context
projector_or_measurement_basis
support_trace
observer_or_governance_scope
residual_amplitudes
abstain_or_hold_reason_if_any
non-authority_boundary

The collapse is then a scoped conventional operation, not an ultimate truth claim.

docs.text: Emptiness blocks self-authorized sharp commitment.

docs.text: Amplitudes and support traces disclose conditions.

docs.title: Two Truths
docs.text: The superposed candidate belongs to a non-fixating ultimate-facing surface; any release is only a conventional scoped surface.

docs.title: Middle Way
docs.text:
The theorem blocks both extremes:

reification collapse: forced sharp self-nature
nihilistic collapse: treating non-sharpness as nothingness

docs.title: 空・縁起・二諦・中道
docs.text:
KuuOS / 空OS begins from a fourfold core:

  1. 空 / Emptiness
  2. 縁起 / Dependent Origination
  3. 二諦 / Two Truths
  4. 中道 / Middle Way

These four are not decorative concepts. They are the first operating principles of KuuOS.

docs.title: 1. 空 / Emptiness
docs.text:
空 means that no object, output, proof, plan, identity, module, or world-model surface possesses independent self-authority.

In KuuOS, emptiness blocks reification.

An answer is not absolute truth by itself. A proof is not execution authority by itself. A memory is not final reality by itself. A model output is not a world by itself.

Operationally, 空 means:

  • no self-subsisting authority,
  • no isolated final claim,
  • no unconditioned execution right,
  • no hidden totalization,
  • every surface must disclose conditions, scope, and relation.

docs.title: 2. 縁起 / Dependent Origination
docs.text:
縁起 means that every valid surface arises through conditions.

In KuuOS, meaning, belief, proof, memory, action, and world-model candidates arise through:

  • causes and conditions,
  • relational traces,
  • observer position,
  • memory lineage,
  • causal support,
  • local-global gluing,
  • constraints and release gates.

Operationally, 縁起 means:

  • every claim requires a condition trace,
  • every plan requires support relations,
  • every memory requires lineage,
  • every decision candidate requires causal and governance context,
  • no single node may dominate the whole network without relational justification.

docs.title: 3. 二諦 / Two Truths
docs.text:
二諦 means that KuuOS separates two surfaces without collapsing one into the other.

  • Ultimate surface: non-fixation, emptiness, non-self-authority, absence of independent essence.
  • Conventional surface: operational models, language, proofs, plans, rules, metrics, clinical workflows, engineering artifacts, and world-model surfaces.

In KuuOS, conventional operation is permitted, but it must not pretend to be absolute ultimate truth.

Operationally, 二諦 means:

  • proof is scoped witness, not metaphysical closure,
  • model output is operational surface, not reality itself,
  • governance status is release scope, not universal truth,
  • practical action remains possible without reifying the action surface,
  • uncertainty and residuals remain visible.

docs.title: 4. 中道 / Middle Way
docs.text:
中道 is the dynamic stabilizer of KuuOS.

It avoids the two collapses:

  1. Reification collapse: treating models, proofs, memories, identities, or rules as absolute.
  2. Nihilistic collapse: treating emptiness as meaninglessness, inaction, or loss of operational responsibility.

Middle Way holds the living gap between ultimate non-fixation and conventional operation.

Operationally, 中道 means:

  • do not absolutize,
  • do not erase,
  • do not force premature closure,
  • do not abandon operational responsibility,
  • preserve the gap that allows repair, re-observation, reflection, and compassionate action.

docs.title: Fourfold Runtime Rule
docs.text:
A KuuOS candidate may move forward only if it satisfies the fourfold check:

Emptiness check:
  Does the candidate avoid self-authorizing or absolute claims?

Dependent-origination check:
  Are its conditions, relations, traces, and supports visible?

Two-truths check:
  Does it preserve the difference between ultimate non-fixation and conventional operation?

Middle-way check:
  Does it avoid both reification and nihilistic abandonment?

If any check fails, the candidate should move to HOLD, REVIEW, REOBSERVE, REPAIR, or FAIL depending on severity.

docs.title: Relation to Later Modules
docs.text:
MemoryOS, BeliefOS, PlanOS, DecisionOS, ReflectionOS, ExplanationOS, RuntimeGovernance, and Self-EvolutionOS are downstream of this fourfold core.

They are not the root. They are operational differentiations of 空・縁起・二諦・中道.

docs.title: 2. The Superstring Theory of Emptiness
docs.text:
The Superstring Theory of Emptiness does not treat strings as fixed self-subsisting things.

A string is read as relational vibration:

  • arising through conditions,
  • constrained by consistency,
  • expressed through boundary and background relations,
  • visible only through an operating surface.

Thus, string is not substance. It is a dependent vibrational relation.

docs.title: 3. 4D Mass Gap
docs.text:
The 4D mass gap gives a nonzero gap between the vacuum surface and stable excitation surface.

Inside the KuuOS interpretation, mass gap is not merely a numerical result. It is the physical model of the two-truths gap:

勝義諦 does not collapse into 世俗諦.
世俗諦 does not become self-grounded absolute reality.
A nonzero gap allows stable effective worlds to arise.

The MGAP4D internal normalized theorem surface includes:

m_gap = 33/20
H_phys psi_* = (33/20) psi_*

This is treated as a KuuOS-internal proof architecture unless and until external review grants a broader public mathematical status.

docs.title: 4. Hidetoshi Itakura's Super-Relativity Theory

docs.text:
Status: confirmed baseline / append-only

This document establishes the KST-Holo / Two-Truth Gap-Holography spine as a core KuuOS baseline.

It is not a replacement for the existing KuuOS fourfold core, Qi / IndraNet surfaces, WORLD model, BeliefOS, DecisionOS, MemoryOS, or claim-surface governance. It is an additive spine connecting them through:

ただし予測から勝義尽尽へは進ませない

docs.title: 1. Core principle
docs.text:
KuuOS is not an OS for claiming total knowledge.

KuuOS is an OS for using records that become stable through gap-mediated conventional appearance while preserving the unrecorded remainder.

stable conventional prediction != ultimate exhaustion
image non-vacuity != kernel collapse
record null != ultimate null
gap-stable != fully flat

The Two-Truth Gap-Holography spine fixes the following core implication:

positive gap
+ positive visible spectral weight
+ gap-holonomy zero
=> unique non-vacuous stable conventional record
=> scoped gap-visible prediction sufficiency

with the hard guardrail:

scoped gap-visible prediction sufficiency
=/=> kernel zero
=/=> UltimateBulk = Image(F_delta)
=/=> ultimate exhaustion
=/=> residue erasure
=/=> full flatness

docs.title: 2. Analytic spine
docs.text:
Let a correlation function satisfy the separated gap expansion

C_A(t) = a_Delta exp(-Delta t) + R_A(t)
0 <= R_A(t) <= M exp(-(Delta + eta)t)
Delta > 0, eta > 0, a_Delta > 0

Then the scaled correlation satisfies

lim_{t -> infinity} exp(Delta t) C_A(t) = a_Delta.

The extracted gap record is

R_Delta(A) = (Delta, a_Delta).

This record is:

unique
non-vacuous
conventional
image-contained
stable under gap-holonomy-zero
prediction-sufficient within declared scope

but it is not an ultimate identity witness.

docs.title: 3. Functorial image placement
docs.text:
Let

F_Delta : UltimateBulk -> ConventionalRecord

be the gap-holographic record functor.

If

F_Delta(X_A) = R_Delta(A),

then

R_Delta(A) in Image(F_Delta).

This establishes conventional image non-vacuity:

exists R in Image(F_Delta), R != record_zero.

This does not authorize:

ker(F_Delta) = 0
UltimateBulk = Image(F_Delta)

The image can contain a non-vacuous record while the unrecorded kernel remains first-class.

docs.title: 4. Gap holonomy and stability
docs.text:
Let Pi_Delta be an additive idempotent gap projection on a prediction record space.

Let

H_gamma = T_gamma - id.

If

Pi_Delta H_gamma Pi_Delta = 0,

then

Pi_Delta T_gamma Pi_Delta = Pi_Delta.

Therefore, for the extracted conventional record:

Pi_Delta T_gamma(Pi_Delta R_Delta) = Pi_Delta R_Delta.

This is gap-visible stability. It is not full flatness.

docs.title: 5. Prediction sufficiency
docs.text:
A stable conventional gap record is prediction-sufficient only under declared scope.

The authorized claim is:

PredictionSufficient_Delta(R_Delta)

The unauthorized claims are:

KernelZeroWitness(F_Delta)
UltimateIdentityWitness(F_Delta)
UltimateExhaustionClaim
FullFlatnessFromGapClosed
ResidueErasure
ScopeFreeTruth

Thus the KST-Holo spine preserves the two-truth boundary:

conventional record useful for prediction
without collapsing into ultimate truth

docs.title: 6. OS binding
docs.text:
The spine binds into KuuOS as follows:

WorldModel
  -> Two-Truth Gap-Holography Spine
  -> BeliefOS
  -> DecisionOS
  -> Claim Surface
  -> Certificate / receipt layer

Role assignments:

  supplies structured world / spectral / process data

Two-Truth Gap-Holography Spine:
  extracts stable conventional records through gap-mediated projection

BeliefOS:
  reads stable records as belief snapshots, without owning truth

  adjudicates scoped prediction sufficiency, without collapsing ultimate residue

Claim Surface:
  authorizes prediction claims and forbids kernel-zero / ultimate-identity claims

Certificate layer:
  exports proof-carrying claim surfaces without exporting forbidden witnesses

docs.title: 7. Fixed baseline points
docs.text:
The following points are fixed as KuuOS baseline invariants:

  1. Positive mass gap plus positive visible spectral weight yields a unique non-vacuous gap-visible conventional record.
  2. The scaled correlation limit is the record coefficient:
lim exp(Delta t) C_A(t) = a_Delta.
  1. The record
R_Delta = (Delta, a_Delta)

is conventional, image-contained, and non-vacuous.

  1. Gap-holonomy zero yields gap-visible stability:
Pi_Delta T_gamma Pi_Delta = Pi_Delta.
  1. Stable conventional record implies scoped prediction sufficiency.
  2. Prediction sufficiency does not authorize kernel collapse.
  3. Prediction sufficiency does not authorize ultimate identity.
  4. Prediction sufficiency does not authorize ultimate exhaustion.
  5. High-mode residue remains visible; gap-stable does not mean fully flat.
  6. All future revisions are append-only and must not overwrite this baseline.

  -> gauge correction / parallel transport

This module is not a recommendation-only bridge. With the initial local backend, it performs actual local state, ledger, and outbox effects through the existing qi_local_execution_adapter_v0_2.

docs.title: Idempotency
docs.text:
Before intervention, v0.3 appends a pending ledger phase. On completion it appends a committed phase. The source covariant action digest is consumed once.

Replaying the same intervention run returns the committed result without a second domain effect. The underlying local adapter also uses the action digest as its execution nonce, providing a second idempotency layer.

docs.title: Gauge formulation
docs.text:
The formal artifact models an effect receipt with intended and realized transports:

F = realized * intended^-1

Under a local frame transformation g, both transports are conjugated and:

F^g = g F g^-1

Thus the statement that an effect is flat is gauge invariant. The proof surface is:

formal/KUOS/OpenHorizon/ActiveGaugeInterventionV0_3.lean
