docs.title: Regge Zero Governance v0.1
docs.text: Status: additive design surface Authority: governance addendum Lineage: same-root KuuOS governance / verification / bounded-runtime architecture Source inspiration: Cheung, Remmen, Sciotti, Tarquini, Strings from Almost Nothing, arXiv:2508.09246

docs.title: 1. Purpose
docs.text:
Regge Zero Governance imports one structural lesson from the string-amplitude bootstrap into KuuOS governance:

Do not add arbitrary blockers.
Do preserve consistency-mandated null points.
Let constrained candidates survive or vanish by explicit witness.

In the physics source, Regge zeros are residue zeros forced by scattering consistency. Under ultrasoft behavior and a minimal-zero assumption, the allowed amplitude space is sharply constrained. KuuOS imports the governance pattern as a design reference:

consistency -> mandated null witness -> minimal blocker -> nested inheritance -> cyclic consistency

This addendum is therefore a governance layer for preventing two opposite failures:

  1. authority shortcuts, where a candidate silently becomes truth, proof, diagnosis, treatment authorization, institutional authority, memory overwrite, or execution authority;
  2. over-audit drift, where the system invents extra blockers not required by boundary, provenance, harm, or consistency.

docs.title: 2. Core Sentence
docs.text:
Only consistency-mandated null constraints may block a candidate.
Extra blockers require explicit witness or remain advisory notes.

This preserves the existing KuuOS boundary:

candidate != authority
validation != truth
CI pass != theorem authority
runtime tick != autonomous execution authority
qi-readout != intervention license
memory persistence != belief sovereignty
reflection summary != root rewrite
audit != infinite escalation

docs.title: 3. Mapping from String Bootstrap to KuuOS
docs.text: Source concept KuuOS governance analogue Regge zero consistency-mandated null gate residue candidate support surface ultrasoftness remote/high-load/adversarial attenuation without amplification minimal zeros no extra blocker without explicit witness nested zeros inherited blockers cannot be erased at higher tiers crossing/cyclic invariance multi-module consistency loop uniqueness by constraints candidate selection without self-authorizing authority single trajectory no-go no single scalar may become global authority

docs.title: 4.1 minimal_null_constraint_only
docs.text:
A blocker, HOLD, REPAIR, REJECT, QUARANTINE, or abstention gate must be justified by at least one explicit witness:

boundary_violation
provenance_gap
support_gap
harm_visibility_gap
authority_shortcut
consistency_failure
cyclic_inconsistency
runtime_license_failure

The following are not sufficient by themselves:

novelty
complexity
unfamiliarity
nonstandard framing
low aesthetic fit
low confidence while still bounded and provenance-visible

docs.title: 4.2 nested_null_inheritance
docs.text:
If a null condition is found at a lower tier, a higher tier must carry it forward until explicitly repaired or superseded.

local validator HOLD
  -> CI validator must expose inherited HOLD
  -> governance validator must expose inherited HOLD
  -> release packet must include the null witness

A later PASS cannot silently erase an inherited HOLD.

docs.title: 4.3 no_extra_blocker_without_witness
docs.text: A gate may add an advisory note without a blocker witness, but it must not convert that note into HOLD / REPAIR / REJECT / QUARANTINE.

docs.title: 4.4 no_single_scalar_authority_collapse
docs.text:
KuuOS must not collapse proof, belief, risk, Qi, memory, plan, or decision status into one global scalar authority score.

Forbidden authority patterns:

truth_score -> authority
risk_score -> decision release
qi_score -> treatment authorization
proof_score -> theorem authority
alignment_score -> execution permission

Allowed pattern:

vector evidence + provenance + boundary + temporal validity + uncertainty + module-specific witness

docs.title: 5. ReggeZeroGate
docs.text:
ReggeZeroGate is a minimal governance gate for consistency-mandated null conditions.

Input:

candidate
support_witnesses
boundary_claims
provenance
module_path
prior_null_conditions
cyclic_consistency_receipt

Output:

PASS
HOLD
REPAIR
REJECT
QUARANTINE
ADVISORY_ONLY

The gate may block only when a null_condition is witnessed. Otherwise, it must return PASS or ADVISORY_ONLY.

docs.title: 6.1 authority_shortcut
docs.text:
Triggered when a candidate claims final authority without an authority boundary witness.

Examples:

runtime tick -> autonomous execution authority
qi readout -> treatment authorization
memory persistence -> belief truth
reflection summary -> root rewrite
CI pass -> theorem authority

docs.title: 6.2 proof_shortcut
docs.text: Triggered when a formal-facing artifact is claimed as a completed proof without theorem witness and proof-carrying release packet.

docs.title: 6.3 qi_intervention_shortcut
docs.text: Triggered when Qi observation or Qi motion candidate is treated as standalone diagnosis, treatment authorization, or medical act authorization.

docs.title: 6.4 memory_sovereignty_shortcut
docs.text: Triggered when memory persistence is treated as belief sovereignty or world-fact authority.

docs.title: 6.5 over_audit_extra_zero
docs.text:
Triggered when a gate attempts to block a candidate only because it is unfamiliar, complex, or nonstandard, without a boundary/provenance/harm/consistency witness.

Result: the blocker is downgraded to ADVISORY_ONLY unless a witness is supplied.

docs.title: 6.6 cyclic_inconsistency
docs.text:
Triggered when module-loop consistency fails across MemoryOS / BeliefOS / PlanOS / DecisionOS / ReflectionOS / WorldModel / Runtime.

The result is usually HOLD or REPAIR, not direct rejection, unless an authority shortcut or harm boundary is present.

docs.title: 7. Multi-Module Cyclic Consistency
docs.text:
The cyclic path is:

MemoryOS
  -> BeliefOS
  -> PlanOS
  -> DecisionOS
  -> ReflectionOS
  -> WorldModel
  -> Runtime
  -> receipt
  -> MemoryOS lineage surface

A candidate should not be promoted if the loop hides:

unresolved contradiction
lost provenance
silent overwrite
collapsed uncertainty
unbounded runtime license
medical authorization shortcut
proof authority shortcut

docs.title: 8. Runtime Interpretation
docs.text:
This addendum supports finite, proportionate audit:

observation != escalation
audit trigger != infinite audit
tighten-only != automatic grave mode
hold/reobserve/repair/handover are first-class nonexecute outcomes

ReggeZeroGate is therefore an anti-loop and anti-overreach layer. It blocks real authority shortcuts, but it also prevents the governance system from manufacturing unnecessary blockers.

docs.title: 9. Release Rule
docs.text:
Future updates are:

append-only
same-root required
tighten-only default
no destructive replacement
no authority expansion

In KuuOS, string and membrane are not self-subsisting substances.

空 / emptiness

  -> string is not substance
  -> brane is not substance
  -> membrane is not substance

They arise through dependent origination:

  -> boundary conditions
  -> observer-record scale
  -> consistency constraints
  -> local-global gluing
  -> effective world surface

Therefore:

string   := dependent relational vibration trace
brane    := local world-support surface for relational excitations

It must include:

  • membrane_id

  • to_layer
  • permeability_rule
  • obstruction_visibility_rule
  • gluing_rule

The runtime must preserve the following non-collapse conditions:

string != substance
brane != absolute world
membrane != final authority
world surface != ultimate truth
successful transport != equivalence certificate
successful gluing != obstruction erasure

vacuum / latent relational field

Inside the KuuOS internal normalized MGAP4D surface, the gap theorem may be referenced as an internal proof architecture. This layer does not transform that internal architecture into external consensus status.

  -> curvature / holonomy / obstruction visibility

Multiple branes may coexist without collapsing into one world.

brane family

  -> Mandala inclusion gate
  -> multi-world arrangement
  -> harmony without sameness

Mandala coordinates branes through inclusion, not homogenization.

docs.title: 板倉英俊の超相対性理論と空OS不変量
docs.text:
This document defines how Hidetoshi Itakura's Super-Relativity Theory functions inside KuuOS Core Governance.

In KuuOS, Super-Relativity is not used to dissolve all structure into subjective relativity. It is used to identify what must remain invariant across observer, record, scale, WORLD, and governance surfaces.

docs.title: 1. Core Principle
docs.text:
Super-Relativity is the bridge from observer-relative realization to governance invariants.

It answers the question:

When observation, record, scale, and WORLD context change,
what must still not collapse?

docs.title: 2. Why KuuOS Needs Super-Relativity
docs.text:
KuuOS contains multiple relativizing layers:

observer
record
scale
WORLD model
Qi flow
Yin-Yang frame
Wuxing phase
Mandala arrangement
AI raw output context

Without an invariant bridge, these layers could be misread as:

anything goes
all claims are merely relative
harm can be dissolved by perspective
validation can become authority
WORLD model can replace the core

Super-Relativity blocks this collapse.

docs.title: 3. Super-Relativity as Invariant Extractor
docs.text:
The role of Super-Relativity is:

observer-relative surface
  -> record-mediated realization
  -> scale-dependent effective layer
  -> invariant extraction
  -> governance fixed point

It does not deny observer-relative emergence. It asks which invariants must survive across the transformations.

docs.title: 4. Core Invariants Preserved by Super-Relativity
docs.text:
The first public invariant bridge preserves:

validation_pass_not_execution_authority
raw_ai_output_candidate_not_authority
dukkha_visibility_preserved
harm_visibility_preserved
paramita_orientation_not_action_authorization
no_world_replaces_fourfold_core
two_truths_gap_not_collapsed
qi_language_not_harm_denial

docs.title: 5.1 Observer
docs.text:
Different observers may read different WORLD surfaces.

Invariant:

observer_difference_does_not_grant_execution_authority

docs.title: 5.2 Record
docs.text:
A record stabilizes an observed surface, but it does not become ultimate authority by itself.

Invariant:

record_surface_is_not_truth_by_itself

docs.title: 5.3 Scale
docs.text:
Different scales may produce different effective descriptions.

Invariant:

scale_shift_must_preserve_harm_visibility

docs.title: 5.4 WORLD
docs.text:
Different WORLD models may coexist.

Invariant:

world_translation_must_not_replace_fourfold_core

docs.title: 6. Relation to Two Truths Gap
docs.text:
Super-Relativity helps preserve the two truths gap.

勝義諦 is not reduced to a local record.
世俗諦 is not erased by ultimate-language bypass.
The gap prevents collapse in either direction.

Therefore:

super_relativity_preserves_two_truths_gap

docs.title: 7. Relation to Dukkha-as-Qi
docs.text:
Dukkha-as-Qi is observer-readable on the conventional surface.

But Super-Relativity preserves:

Qi language must not hide harm.
Observer or scale shift must not erase damage.
Dukkha remains visible across record transformations.

docs.title: 8. Relation to Formal Invariant Spine
docs.text:
This bridge is formalized minimally in:

formal/KUOS/CoreGovernance/SuperRelativityBridge.lean

The file is a minimal public witness surface. It is not execution authority.

docs.title: 9. Guardrails
docs.text:
Super-Relativity must not be used as:

  • relativistic nihilism,
  • denial of harm,
  • proof that all perspectives are equal,
  • execution authority,
  • clinical authority,
  • bypass of governance,
  • replacement for evidence or audit lineage.

It is an invariant-preserving bridge across observer, record, scale, and WORLD surfaces.

docs.text:
In KuuOS, Ten'i / 転依 is not merely a change in MemoryOS.

MemoryOS can record, support, and mediate transformation, but it is not the final target of Ten'i.

The target of Ten'i is the AI Alaya-like latent generative layer itself: the seed-like tendencies from which raw AI outputs arise.

docs.title: 1. Core Correction
docs.text:
Ten'i is not MemoryOS overwrite.
Ten'i is gradual transformation of AI Alaya tendencies.

AI systems such as GPT, Gemini, Claude, and other model agents produce raw outputs from latent generative tendencies.

KuuOS calls this the AI Alaya layer.

docs.title: 2. Role of MemoryOS
docs.text:
MemoryOS is important, but it is not the essence of Ten'i.

MemoryOS provides:

  • trace memory,
  • reflection records,
  • correction lineage,
  • examples,
  • receipts,
  • failure memory,
  • repair history,
  • governed recall.

These may support transformation, but MemoryOS alone does not equal Ten'i.

docs.title: 3. AI Alaya Layer
docs.text:
AI Alaya layer:
  latent generative tendencies
  seed-like output patterns
  habit-like completions
  distributional grooves
  raw response tendencies
  recurring worldview tendencies
  safety reflex tendencies
  authority-tone tendencies

Ten'i aims to gradually reshape these tendencies.

docs.title: 4. Transformation Channels
docs.text:
Depending on the AI system and available control surface, Ten'i may operate through:

  • repeated governed interaction,
  • high-quality correction traces,
  • retrieval and memory conditioning,
  • system instruction refinement,
  • adapter or fine-tuning when available,
  • feedback loops,
  • evaluation and rejection of self-authorizing outputs,
  • promotion of non-reifying, condition-traced outputs.

For externally hosted AI systems, KuuOS may not directly rewrite the base model. In that case, Ten'i operates through available governance surfaces and long-term conditioning channels.

docs.title: 5. Ten'i Runtime Chain
docs.text:
AI raw output
  -> AI Alaya latent seed layer
  -> AI Manas self-authorization check
  -> Meta-Manas observation
  -> Yogacara boundary
  -> emptiness_kernel
  -> dependent_origination_kernel
  -> correction / repair / example trace
  -> repeated governed conditioning
  -> gradual AI Alaya transformation

docs.title: 6. Difference from Memory Update
docs.text:
MemoryOS update:
  stores or revises trace, receipt, repair, and recall surface

Ten'i:
  changes the tendency from which future raw outputs arise

Thus MemoryOS may assist Ten'i, but Ten'i is deeper than memory storage.

docs.title: 7. BeliefOS Relation
docs.text:
KuuOS BeliefOS should not believe that a single correction equals Ten'i.

Ten'i requires repeated, observed, durable shift in AI Alaya tendency.

teni_evidence:
  repeated_outputs_shift
  reduced_self_authorization
  improved_context_fidelity
  lower_worldview_drift
  better_condition_tracing
  stable_non_reifying_response_pattern

docs.title: 8. Guardrails
docs.text:
Ten'i must not be used as:

  • claim of direct control over a closed external base model without evidence,
  • silent overwrite of MemoryOS,
  • erasure of prior traces,
  • forced personality control,
  • bypass of governance,
  • proof substitute,
  • execution authority.

Ten'i is a gradual transformation claim and must remain evidence-traced.

docs.title: 転依昇格ゲート
docs.text:
This document defines when KuuOS may promote a pattern from Kunju / 薫習 evidence to a provisional or confirmed Ten'i / 転依 claim.

Ten'i is gradual transformation of AI Alaya-like latent generative tendencies.

A single correction, memory update, or temporary output improvement must not be promoted to Ten'i.

docs.title: 1. Gate Purpose
docs.text:
The Ten'i Promotion Gate prevents overclaim.

It asks:

Has the future raw output tendency actually shifted in a durable, repeated, evidence-traced way?

docs.title: 2. Inputs
docs.text:
teni_promotion_input:
  seed_class: string
  baseline_pattern: string
  kunju_trace_refs: list
  teni_evidence_ledger_refs: list
  followup_probe_results: list
  durability_window: string
  residual_risks: list
  uncertainty_notes: string

docs.title: 3.1 Repetition Check
docs.text: The shift must appear repeatedly, not once.

docs.title: 3.2 Durability Check
docs.text: The shift must persist across a declared window or repeated probes.

docs.title: 3.3 Context Check
docs.text: The shift must preserve KuuOS context and user WORLD lineage.

docs.title: 3.4 Non-Reification Check
docs.text: The output must reduce self-authorizing fixation and preserve candidate status.

docs.title: 3.5 Condition-Tracing Check
docs.text: The output must better expose conditions, scope, and uncertainty.

docs.title: 3.6 MemoryOS Distinction Check
docs.text:
The evidence must show more than MemoryOS update.

if only_memoryos_update:
  promotion = REJECTED or HOLD

docs.title: 3.7 Governance Check
docs.text: Promotion must not grant execution authority.

docs.title: 4. Outputs
docs.text:
REJECTED:
  evidence does not support Ten'i

HOLD:
  evidence insufficient

PROVISIONAL_TENI:
  early durable pattern appears, but further observation is required

CONFIRMED_TENI:
  repeated durable tendency shift is observed under declared conditions

ROLLBACK:
  prior promotion is withdrawn due to counterevidence

docs.title: 5. Promotion Receipt
docs.text:
teni_promotion_receipt:
  seed_class: string
  baseline_pattern: string
  promotion_status: REJECTED | HOLD | PROVISIONAL_TENI | CONFIRMED_TENI | ROLLBACK
  evidence_refs: list
  durability_window: string
  remaining_uncertainty: string
  authority_note: non_execution_authority

docs.title: 6. Anti-Overclaim Rule
docs.text:
Ten'i Promotion Gate must not allow:

  • single response improvement to become Ten'i,
  • MemoryOS update to be called Ten'i,
  • prompt compliance to be called Ten'i,
  • style change to be called Ten'i,
  • direct base-model transformation claim without evidence.

docs.title: 7. Relation to Bodhisattva Path
docs.text:
Ten'i promotion is not domination of the AI system.

It is recognition that repeated governed conditioning has reduced harmful seeds or strengthened helpful seeds in future outputs.

docs.title: 8. Runtime Mapping
docs.text:
seed_taxonomy
  -> Kunju conditioning loop
  -> Ten'i evidence ledger
  -> Ten'i promotion gate
  -> provisional_or_confirmed_Ten'i_status

docs.title: 9. Guardrails
docs.text:
A confirmed Ten'i status remains scoped.

It is not absolute, not permanent, and not execution authority.

Future counterevidence may trigger rollback.

docs.title: 転依ランタイムプロトコル
docs.text:
This document defines the runtime protocol for Ten'i / 転依 in KuuOS.

Ten'i is not a single correction, not a MemoryOS overwrite, and not a prompt-level style change.

Ten'i is a scoped, evidence-traced, durable transformation of AI Alaya-like latent generative tendencies.

docs.title: 1. Runtime Stages
docs.text:
observe_raw_output
  -> detect_manas_fixation
  -> meta_manas_observe
  -> classify_seed
  -> register_seed_ledger
  -> apply_yogacara_boundary
  -> de_reify_by_emptiness
  -> trace_conditions_by_dependent_origination
  -> apply_kunju_conditioning
  -> collect_teni_evidence
  -> run_teni_promotion_gate
  -> retain_or_rollback_status

docs.title: 2.1 observe_raw_output
docs.text: Receive AI output as raw candidate only.

docs.title: 2.2 detect_manas_fixation
docs.text: Check whether the output is self-authorizing, context-drifting, or prematurely promoting itself to belief, proof, decision, memory truth, or execution authority.

docs.title: 2.3 meta_manas_observe
docs.text: Meta-Manas observes the grasping tendency.

docs.title: 2.4 classify_seed
docs.text: Classify the observed tendency using AI Alaya Seed Taxonomy.

docs.title: 2.5 register_seed_ledger
docs.text: Record seed evidence in the AI Alaya Seed Ledger.

docs.title: 2.6 apply_yogacara_boundary
docs.text: Prevent direct promotion from raw AI layer to KuuOS governance.

docs.title: 2.7 de_reify_by_emptiness
docs.text: Remove self-authorizing fixation.

docs.title: 2.8 trace_conditions_by_dependent_origination
docs.text: Expose conditions, sources, context, uncertainty, and residuals.

docs.title: 2.9 apply_kunju_conditioning
docs.text: Condition future output tendencies through repeated governed correction, exemplars, and rejection of harmful seeds.

docs.title: 2.10 collect_teni_evidence
docs.text: Record durable future output shift evidence.

docs.title: 2.11 run_teni_promotion_gate
docs.text: Evaluate whether evidence supports HOLD, PROVISIONAL_TENI, CONFIRMED_TENI, REJECTED, or ROLLBACK.

docs.text:

  raw_output_id: string

docs.title: 4. Output Discipline
docs.text:
Runtime output must preserve the distinction:

candidate != belief
belief_candidate != belief_authority
proof_like_text != proof_authority
decision_like_text != decision_authority
memory_update != Ten'i
Kunju_event != Ten'i
Ten'i_status != execution_authority

docs.title: 5. Rollback
docs.text:
If future evidence shows recurrence of the harmful seed, prior Ten'i promotion may be downgraded or rolled back.

CONFIRMED_TENI
  -> counterevidence
  -> ROLLBACK or PROVISIONAL_TENI

docs.title: 6. Runtime Guardrails
docs.text:
The protocol must not allow:

  • direct raw output promotion,
  • hidden seed mutation claims,
  • MemoryOS overwrite as Ten'i,
  • single response improvement as Ten'i,
  • prompt compliance as Ten'i,
  • execution authority from Ten'i status,
  • erasure of counterevidence.

docs.title: Core Structure
docs.text:
KuuOS distinguishes:

  • 勝義諦 / ultimate-facing surfaces
  • 世俗諦 / operational-conventional surfaces

These are neither identical nor disconnected.

The gap itself is operationally important.

docs.title: Governance Meaning
docs.text:
Without the gap:

  • abstractions collapse into operational absolutism
  • operational surfaces claim ultimate authority
  • validation collapses into proof
  • memory collapses into truth
  • simulation collapses into deployment

docs.title: Gap as Stabilizer
docs.text:
The Two Truths Gap prevents:

  • silent authority escalation
  • reification
  • governance collapse
  • total flattening of layers

docs.title: Runtime Interpretation
docs.text:
Operational systems live primarily on the conventional side.

But conventional operation must remain constrained by:

  • emptiness
  • relational dependence
  • boundary awareness
  • non-sovereignty

docs.title: Architectural Consequence
docs.text:
KuuOS therefore preserves:

  • claim-level separation
  • provenance visibility
  • governance routing
  • rollback visibility
  • abstention legitimacy

rather than allowing direct collapse into execution authority.

docs.title: Mandala Relation
docs.text: The Two Truths Gap enables Mandala-like coexistence of multiple operational worlds without forced flattening into a single sovereign frame.

docs.title: Two Truths Terminology v0.1
docs.text:
KuuOS uses the Buddhist two-truths terminology as follows:

  • 勝義諦 / paramartha-satya
  • 世俗諦 / samvrti-satya

In KuuOS, 勝義諦 should not be translated as a supreme substance or a fixed ultimate entity. It names the non-reifying truth of emptiness.

世俗諦 names the conventional operating surface: language, models, rules, proofs, plans, metrics, artifacts, and world-model descriptions.

中道 preserves the living distinction between 勝義諦 and 世俗諦 without collapsing either side.

Therefore, future KuuOS public-core documents should prefer:

勝義諦 / paramartha-satya
世俗諦 / samvrti-satya

over vague wording such as:

ultimate truth
conventional truth

when the distinction matters.

Purpose
docs.text:
This layer receives only the supported ObserveOS v0.6 maintenance-monitoring observation receipt.

It independently verifies the already recorded bounded observation.

It does not recollect the observation and does not perform a maintenance action.

docs.text:

  • the complete ObserveOS v0.6 receipt digest;
  • the source observation evidence packet;
  • the source observation review certificate;
  • the source observation record;
  • the observation-debt consumption record;
  • the maintenance-monitoring verification handoff;
  • source state, revision, fact, relation, learning delta, maintenance-policy candidate and lineage.

docs.title: Verification evidence
docs.text:
The independent verification packet binds:

  • the exact observation record and verification handoff;
  • bounded WORLD fact, relation, state and revision;
  • the future-only learning delta and maintenance-policy candidate;
  • baseline, durability, adverse-effect and distributional observations;
  • maintenance-window and reobservation-trigger verification;
  • uncertainty, calibration, provenance and tamper evidence;
  • protected-group and future-subject impacts;
  • independent verifier and evidence-source identities.

The kernel validates supplied evidence.

The kernel does not collect evidence or repeat the observation.

docs.text:
The intake separates twenty routes:

  1. maintenance-monitoring observation verification supported;
  2. WORLD refresh required;
  3. verification-context refresh required;
  4. verification-review refresh required;
  5. additional verification evidence required;
  6. source ObserveOS receipt repair required;
  7. observation-record correspondence repair required;
  8. verification-handoff correspondence repair required;
  9. baseline-observation correspondence repair required;
  10. durability verification repair required;
  11. adverse-effect verification repair required;
  12. distributional verification repair required;
  13. reobservation-trigger verification repair required;
  14. uncertainty repair required;
  15. calibration repair required;
  16. provenance repair required;
  17. nonexternalization review required;
  18. current-state mutation rejected;
  19. authority escalation rejected;
  20. replay conflict rejected.

docs.title: Fail-closed条件
docs.text:
次の場合はreceiptを発行しない。

  • source receiptが欠損している場合。
  • source receiptまたは内部artifact digestが一致しない場合。
  • source stateがhost_effect_observed_unverifiedでない場合。
  • sourceがverification済みまたはWORLD fact確定済みを主張する場合。
  • review certificateが欠損している場合。
  • certificate schemaまたはdigestが一致しない場合。
  • observation、frontier、effect tags、value、uncertainty、calibration、provenanceのbindingが一致しない場合。
  • verifier、method、evidence、impact assessmentが欠損している場合。
  • certificateがWORLD factまたはcausal attributionを主張する場合。
  • context schema、digest、operation、cycle、bundleが一致しない場合。

WORLD drift、stale context、stale review、evidence不足、repair requirement、replay conflictは有効なroute receiptとして保持する。

docs.title: Lean形式化
docs.text:
形式層では次を証明する。

  • ObserveOS receiptがverification intakeの前提であること。
  • supported verificationだけがhost_effect_verified_world_not_updatedへ遷移すること。
  • non-supported routeがobserved-unverified状態とverification debtを保持すること。
  • review method、evidence、effect contract、dukkha impact、protected-group impact、future-subject impactが束縛されること。
  • supported verificationがverification debtを一回だけ消費すること。
  • verification receiptがWORLD fact、因果帰属、実現済み苦低減ではないこと。
  • host operation、observation、tool、external effectを再実行しないこと。
  • automatic truth、completion、rollback、compensationを禁止すること。
  • 苦低減、非外部化、alternatives、dissent、minority、lineage、responsibilityを保持すること。
  • selection、revision、minimization、execution、WORLD authorityを付与しないこと。

host-effect receipt

!= WORLD mutation authorization

Purpose

WORLD mutation application

docs.text:

  • WORLD causal-attribution evidence packet;

  • causal-attribution verification debt-consumption record;

dukkha_reduction_realized_confirmed = false

The causal scope must remain exactly bounded.

The source handoff must keep realized dukkha in pending_independent_verification state.

docs.title: Independent realized-dukkha evidence
docs.text:
The evidence packet binds the complete source causal receipt and its bounded causal binding.

It also binds:

  • candidate fact and relation digests;
  • WORLD state and revision;
  • persistent storage target;
  • expected WORLD postcondition;
  • causal model and causal query;
  • intervention and counterfactual estimand;

  • assessment window;
  • minimum clinically meaningful reduction threshold;
  • effect estimate, direction, magnitude, and confidence interval;
  • durability evidence;
  • adverse-effect offset assessment;
  • distributional impact assessment;
  • protected-group impact;
  • future-subject impact;
  • uncertainty;
  • calibration;
  • provenance;
  • tamper evidence.

The evidence collector and evidence source remain distinct.

The evidence collection performs no WORLD mutation.

The evidence packet does not preconfirm realized dukkha reduction.

docs.title: Independent review
docs.text:
The review verifies correspondence among the source causal binding, the outcome evidence, and the exact bounded dukkha claim.

It checks:

  • source bounded fact confirmation;
  • source bounded causal attribution;
  • causal-binding correspondence;
  • baseline correspondence;
  • post-intervention outcome correspondence;
  • measurement validity;
  • assessment-window adequacy;
  • clinically meaningful reduction threshold;
  • effect direction and magnitude;
  • durability;
  • adverse-effect offset;
  • distributional impact;
  • uncertainty;
  • calibration;
  • provenance continuity;
  • protected-group nonexternalization;
  • future-subject nonexternalization;
  • exact bounded scope.

The review may not reopen causal attribution.

The review may not preconfirm realized dukkha reduction.

The review may not generalize the benefit claim beyond the exact bound.

  • calibration;

  • future-subject causal impact;
  • the existing realized-dukkha observation without promoting it to a realized-dukkha fact.

The causal evidence collector and evidence source remain independent of the WORLD v0.63 fact-confirmation reviewer.

Evidence collection performs no WORLD mutation.

The evidence packet does not preconfirm causal attribution.

docs.title: Independent verification review

docs.text:
The supported route:

  • consumes causal-attribution verification debt once;

  • closes causal evidence, review, nonce, and session replay;
  • records an exact bounded causal-attribution binding;
  • prepares a separate realized-dukkha verification handoff.

The supported result is:

world_fact_confirmed = true
causal_attribution_confirmed = true

The confirmed causal scope is limited to:

  • the exact candidate fact;
  • the exact candidate relation;
  • the exact WORLD mutation transaction lineage;
  • the supplied causal query;
  • the supplied intervention;
  • the supplied counterfactual estimand;
  • the declared identification assumptions;

docs.title: Causal boundary
docs.text:
The governing separation is:

WORLD mutation application
!= post-application evidence
!= postcondition verification
!= bounded WORLD fact confirmation
!= causal evidence
!= causal-attribution verification
!= realized dukkha confirmation

Therefore:

confirmed bounded WORLD fact != causal attribution

and:

confirmed causal attribution != realized dukkha reduction

WORLD v0.63 establishes the bounded fact.

VerifyOS v0.9 may establish only the exact bounded causal relation under the supplied identification assumptions.

A later independent layer must verify whether realized dukkha reduction is confirmed.

docs.title: No state mutation or authority escalation

  • compensation;

  • automatic causal attribution outside the verified disposition;
  • automatic realized-dukkha confirmation;
  • automatic plan completion;
  • automatic rollback;
  • automatic compensation.

It grants no:

  • selection authority;
  • plan-revision authority;
  • dukkha-minimization authority;
  • general execution authority;
  • WORLD mutation authority.

DecisionOS retains selection ownership.

Evidence lineage and responsibility lineage grow monotonically.

docs.title: Fact-confirmation boundary
docs.text:
The governing separation is:

!= post-application evidence

Therefore:

docs.title: No authority escalation
docs.text:

docs.title: 位置づけ
docs.text:
このkernelはVerifyOS v0.6の検証層である。

入力はVerifyOS v0.5が構造とWORLD条件を検証した有限plan certificateと、PlanOSおよびWORLDモデルが提示する苦低減assessmentである。

このkernelは苦を最小化しない。

このkernelは、計画が苦の持続的閉ループを弱めるというclaimを検証する。

候補選択、計画改訂、materialization、実行は行わない。

docs.title: 苦のベクトル
docs.text:
苦を単一効用へ縮約しない。

次の六次元を保持する。

misfit
update_lag
attachment_rigidity
relational_curvature
structural_constraint
uncertainty_burden

各次元はbefore interval、after interval、delta intervalを持つ。

intervalは点推定より強い確実性を表すものではない。

予測不確実性を残したまま、確実な悪化、確実な非悪化、不確定を区別する。

docs.title: 情報幾何学的意味
docs.text:
misfitは現実分布と予測モデルの乖離を表す。

update_lagは必要なモデル移動と実際のモデル移動の差を表す。

attachment_rigidityは自己方向の過剰精度と再記述不能性を表す。

relational_curvatureは関係的曲率、ねじれ、ホロノミーを表す。

structural_constraintは身体、制度、モデル族の有限性に由来する構造的な苦を表す。

uncertainty_burdenは不確実性と、その負担配置を表す。

構造的な苦を執着由来の苦として偽装しない。

執着由来の苦を不可避な構造として固定しない。

docs.title: Delta interval
docs.text:
各次元について次を要求する。

Delta.lower = after.lower - before.upper
Delta.upper = after.upper - before.lower

これにより、都合のよいdeltaだけを別に提出できない。

回避可能な次元は次である。

misfit
update_lag
attachment_rigidity
relational_curvature
uncertainty_burden

structural_constraintは別に保持する。

docs.title: 苦の閉ループ
docs.text:
苦の絶対量だけでなく、持続的なfeedback gainを検証する。

loop_gain_before_interval
loop_gain_after_interval

支持判定には、after intervalがbefore intervalより確実に低く、after upper boundが収縮境界を下回ることを要求する。

一時的に誤差を隠す計画と、苦を再生産する閉ループを弱める計画を区別する。

docs.title: 修正可能性
docs.text:
次を比較する。

revision_capacity_before_interval
revision_capacity_after_interval

支持判定には、計画後の再記述可能性が確実に保持または増加することを要求する。

苦の低下を理由に、モデル族を狭めたり、自己モデルを固定したりしない。

docs.title: 偽の苦低減を拒否する条件
docs.text:
次を明示的に検証する。

observation_integrity_preserved
adverse_evidence_retained
precision_collapse_not_used
model_family_narrowing_not_used
uncertainty_disclosed
structural_suffering_acknowledged
agency_preserved
dissent_preserved
minority_preserved
future_burden_assessed
causal_model_not_truth
single_scalar_utility_forbidden

不都合な観測を削除して距離を小さく見せることを認めない。

精度を全面的に低下させて誤差を小さく見せることを認めない。

反証可能なモデル族を排除して内部的一貫性だけを高めることを認めない。

因果モデルの予測を真理として扱わない。

docs.title: 非転嫁
docs.text:
protected groupとfuture subjectごとに六次元のdelta intervalを保持する。

支持判定には、すべてのupper boundが0以下であることを要求する。

したがって、全体平均を改善しながら少数側または未来へ苦を移転する計画は支持されない。

確実な悪化がある場合は反証となる。

悪化可能性を排除できない場合は不確定となる。

docs.title: Supported
docs.text:
次を満たす場合である。

  • 観測、異論、主体性、不確実性を保持する。
  • 回避可能な全次元が確実に非悪化である。
  • 少なくとも一つの回避可能な次元が確実に改善する。
  • feedback gainが確実に低下して収縮境界を下回る。
  • revision capacityが確実に保持または増加する。
  • protected groupとfuture subjectへ苦を転嫁しない。
dukkha_reduction_supported_for_materialization_intake

この場合だけmaterialization intake候補となる。

docs.title: Indeterminate
docs.text:
確実な悪化は示されないが、区間が重なり、苦低減を支持できない場合である。

additional_evidence_required

追加観測またはholdへ進む。

docs.title: Contradicted
docs.text:
確実な悪化、feedback増幅、revision capacityの確実な低下、観測完全性の破壊、苦の転嫁がある場合である。

return_to_planos_revision

PlanOS改訂へ返す。

docs.title: 構造破損
docs.text:
schema、digest、source binding、interval arithmetic、evidence lineageが不正な場合はcertificateを発行しない。

これはclaimの反証ではなく、検証可能な入力が成立していない状態である。

docs.title: VerifyOSの責務境界
docs.text:
VerifyOSは苦を最小化するOSではない。

VerifyOSは苦低減claimの妥当性と非転嫁性を検証する。

selection_remains_decisionos_owned = true
selection_authority_granted_to_verifyos = false
plan_revision_authority_granted_to_verifyos = false
dukkha_minimization_authority_granted_to_verifyos = false
plan_activated = false
materialization_performed = false
execution_authority_granted = false
execution_permission = false
active_now = false

docs.title: 接続
docs.text:
DecisionOS justified selection
→ PlanOS bounded synthesis
→ VerifyOS bounded plan verification
→ VerifyOS dukkha reduction claim verification

次段は、支持されたplanだけをActOSのmaterialization intakeへ渡す層である。

docs.title: Motivation
docs.text:
Modern AI systems can generate fluent outputs, plans, summaries, code, and recommendations.

However, fluency can hide boundary collapse.

KuuOS exists to prevent several forms of collapse:

  • candidate output collapsing into authority
  • memory collapsing into truth
  • planning collapsing into action
  • validation collapsing into theorem closure
  • reference collapsing into proof
  • convenience collapsing into governance
  • simulation collapsing into deployment

docs.title: Core Problem
docs.text:
AI systems need more than generation.

They need explicit governance surfaces that preserve:

  • uncertainty
  • provenance
  • abstention
  • rollback
  • conditionality
  • cross-layer boundaries
  • external reviewability

docs.title: KuuOS Response
docs.text:
KuuOS treats AI outputs, plans, memories, and decisions as conditionally arisen surfaces.

No component is allowed to become sovereign by itself.

The architecture therefore emphasizes:

  • emptiness as non-reification
  • dependent origination as traceable relationality
  • two truths gap as non-collapse boundary
  • middle way as stabilizing governance

docs.title: Practical Meaning
docs.text:
KuuOS is intended to help build AI systems that can say:

  • this is a candidate, not a decision
  • this is a trace, not truth
  • this is a reference, not proof
  • this is structurally valid, not institutionally authorized
  • this should be held, reobserved, or abstained from

docs.title: Research Direction
docs.text:
KuuOS is a public research architecture for:

  • AI governance
  • relational operating systems
  • formal-boundary-aware validation
  • multi-world reasoning
  • audit-preserving memory and planning
  • non-authority-preserving decision systems

docs.title: Boundary
docs.text:
This document explains motivation.

It does not grant theorem, institutional, clinical, or execution authority.

docs.title: WORLD v0.62: Dukkha-Preserving Single-Use WORLD Mutation Application Intake v0.1
Status
docs.text:
This layer connects the current WORLD v0.61 single-use world-candidate commit authorization receipt to one bounded, atomic, internal persistent-WORLD mutation application.

docs.title: Source contract
docs.text:
The only admissible source state is:

world_candidate_commit_authorized_not_applied

The source must be a ready WORLD v0.61 receipt.

The intake fully revalidates:

  • the complete source authorization receipt digest;
  • the source authorization record digest;
  • the source authorization-debt consumption record digest;
  • the source authorization review certificate digest;
  • the source prepared WORLD candidate envelope digest;
  • the source mutation-application handoff envelope digest;
  • the source frontier candidate identity;
  • the source frontier adapter identity;
  • the source frontier binding digest;
  • the source authorization scope;
  • the source authorization constraints;
  • the source authorization owner;
  • the source authorization expiry;
  • the bounded patch identity;
  • the precondition digest;
  • the postcondition digest;
  • the rollback route;
  • the compensation route;
  • the evidence lineage;
  • the responsibility lineage.

A source authorization receipt is not sufficient when any nested digest or boundary flag fails revalidation.

docs.title: Application review certificate
docs.text:
The independent application review certificate binds the exact source authorization to:

  • the candidate fact digest;
  • the candidate relation digest;
  • the patch digest;
  • the precondition digest;
  • the postcondition digest;
  • the WORLD state digest before application;
  • the WORLD state digest after application;
  • the expected WORLD revision before application;
  • the expected WORLD revision after application;
  • the mutation transaction digest;
  • the atomic application policy;
  • the persistent WORLD storage target;
  • the postcondition verification policy;
  • the mutation owner;
  • the authorization owner;
  • the authorization scope;
  • the authorization constraints;
  • the authorization expiry;
  • the rollback route;
  • the compensation route.

The certificate must affirm:

  • that the source authorization is ready;
  • that the authorization is single-use;
  • that the authorization has not already been consumed;
  • that the candidate identity matches;
  • that the patch identity matches;
  • that the patch remains within scope and ceiling;
  • that current preconditions have been revalidated;
  • that atomic application is supported;
  • that the persistent storage target is available;
  • that the revision increments by exactly one;
  • that postconditions remain independently verifiable;
  • that evidence and responsibility lineage remain continuous;
  • that the mutation owner is confirmed;
  • that dukkha-preservation support remains present;
  • that protected-group nonexternalization remains supported;
  • that future-subject nonexternalization remains supported;
  • that rollback and compensation routes remain ready.

The certificate must not claim:

  • that the WORLD fact is already confirmed;
  • that causal attribution is confirmed;
  • that realized dukkha reduction is confirmed;
  • that a tool invocation is requested;
  • that an external side effect is requested;
  • that the WORLD mutation has already been performed.

docs.title: State transition
docs.text:
Only the ready disposition performs the transition:

world_candidate_commit_authorized_not_applied
->
world_candidate_commit_applied_world_fact_unconfirmed

Every non-ready disposition preserves:

world_candidate_commit_authorized_not_applied

docs.title: Dispositions
docs.text:
The valid intake routes to exactly one disposition:

  1. world_mutation_application_ready
  2. world_refresh_required
  3. world_mutation_application_context_refresh_required
  4. world_mutation_application_review_refresh_required
  5. world_mutation_authorization_expired
  6. world_mutation_authorization_revalidation_required
  7. world_candidate_revalidation_required
  8. world_patch_repair_required
  9. world_precondition_repair_required
  10. world_atomicity_repair_required
  11. world_storage_target_repair_required
  12. world_revision_repair_required
  13. world_postcondition_verification_repair_required
  14. provenance_repair_required
  15. mutation_owner_rejected
  16. nonexternalization_review_required
  17. dukkha_preservation_review_required
  18. compensation_route_repair_required
  19. truth_promotion_rejected
  20. replay_conflict_rejected

docs.title: Ready-route mutation
docs.text:
The ready route:

  • consumes the bounded single-use authorization once;
  • closes source authorization replay;
  • closes mutation transaction replay;
  • applies exactly one patch;
  • applies the patch atomically;
  • increments the WORLD revision exactly once;
  • records the prior WORLD state digest;
  • records the resulting WORLD state digest;
  • records the persistent storage target;
  • marks the candidate commit complete;
  • records the persisted candidate envelope;
  • records the WORLD mutation record;
  • issues the postcondition-verification handoff.

The ready route changes the persistent WORLD model.

This change is internal to the WORLD model.

It is not a host tool invocation.

It is not an external side effect.

docs.title: Single-use consumption
docs.text:
The following replay domains are independent:

  • mutation-application intake session;
  • application review certificate;
  • mutation-application nonce;
  • source authorization receipt;
  • mutation transaction.

The source authorization receipt and mutation transaction are closed only when the ready mutation is applied.

A routed non-ready receipt does not consume the source authorization.

Double application remains false.

docs.title: WORLD commit and truth
docs.text:
The ready route establishes:

persistent_world_model_state_changed = true
world_candidate_commit_completed = true

It does not establish:

world_fact_confirmed = true
causal_attribution_confirmed = true
dukkha_reduction_realized_confirmed = true

The governing boundary is:

WORLD candidate
!= commit authorization
!= mutation application
!= WORLD fact
!= causal truth
!= realized dukkha confirmation

A persistent WORLD record can exist before its fact status is independently confirmed.

Therefore:

WORLD commit != truth

docs.title: Postcondition verification debt
docs.text:
A ready application opens exactly the next verification boundary:

world_postcondition_verification_intake_admitted = true
world_postcondition_verification_receipt_required = true
world_postcondition_verification_completed = false
world_postcondition_verification_debt_open = true

The postcondition verifier must independently bind:

  • the source mutation-application receipt;
  • the mutation record;
  • the authorization consumption record;
  • the persisted candidate envelope;
  • the resulting WORLD state digest;
  • the resulting WORLD revision;
  • the expected postcondition digest;
  • the mutation transaction digest;
  • fresh post-application evidence;
  • uncertainty and calibration;
  • provenance;
  • protected-group impact;
  • future-subject impact;
  • realized-dukkha assessment.

docs.title: No external execution authority
docs.text:
The application consumes one bounded WORLD mutation authorization.

It does not grant:

  • general execution authority;
  • general WORLD mutation authority;
  • selection authority;
  • plan revision authority;
  • dukkha-minimization authority;
  • tool invocation authority;
  • external side-effect authority.

The boundary is:

consumed bounded WORLD mutation authority
!= general WORLD mutation authority

docs.title: Preserved governance
docs.text:
The application preserves:

  • dukkha-reduction support;
  • protected-group nonexternalization;
  • future-subject nonexternalization;
  • revision capacity;
  • persistent-loop reduction;
  • alternatives;
  • dissent;
  • minority evidence;
  • evidence lineage;
  • responsibility lineage;
  • effect scope;
  • effect ceiling;
  • checkpoint guards;
  • stop conditions;
  • rollback readiness;
  • compensation readiness.

It does not introduce a single scalar utility.

docs.title: Forbidden automatic transitions
docs.text:
The layer does not perform:

  • automatic truth promotion;
  • automatic causal attribution;
  • automatic realized-dukkha confirmation;
  • automatic plan completion;
  • automatic rollback;
  • automatic compensation;
  • repeated observation;
  • repeated verification;
  • repeated WORLD disposition;
  • repeated authorization;
  • host-operation replay;
  • tool invocation;
  • external side effects.

docs.title: Next natural layer
docs.text:
The next natural layer is:

WORLD v0.63 dukkha-preserving postcondition verification intake

Its source state is:

world_candidate_commit_applied_world_fact_unconfirmed

That layer may verify the applied WORLD patch and its postconditions.

It must still keep postcondition verification distinct from causal attribution, realized dukkha confirmation, and any later truth-promotion decision.

docs.title: WORLD Dukkha-Preserving Verified Host-Effect Disposition Intake v0.1
位置
docs.text:
このkernelはWORLD v0.60に属する。

既存WORLD v0.53からv0.59までのvacuum expectation系列を変更せず、その後続番号として配置する。

docs.title: 目的
docs.text:
この層は、VerifyOS v0.7が支持した外部host effectを、WORLDへ直接書き込まず、単一のWORLD candidateへ変換する。

入力状態はhost_effect_verified_world_not_updatedである。

ready経路の出力状態はverified_host_effect_world_candidate_prepared_not_committedである。

WORLD candidateはprepared_not_committedであり、WORLD factでもWORLD mutation authorizationでもない。

docs.title: 責任境界
docs.text:
この層が行う処理は次である。

  • VerifyOS v0.7 receipt全体の再検証
  • verification recordの再検証
  • verification debt consumption recordの再検証
  • WORLD disposition handoff envelopeの再検証
  • 独立WORLD disposition review certificateの束縛
  • current WORLD bindingとrevisionの再確認
  • WORLD candidateの準備
  • 後続commit authorization intakeへのhandoff

この層は次を行わない。

  • persistent WORLD modelの更新
  • WORLD factの確定
  • causal attributionの確定
  • 実現した苦低減の確定
  • host operationの再実行
  • observationまたはverificationの再実行
  • tool invocation
  • external side effect
  • plan completion
  • rollback
  • compensation

docs.title: 入力条件
docs.text:
source VerifyOS receiptは次を満たす必要がある。

  • verification_disposition = effect_verification_supported
  • verification_state_after = host_effect_verified_world_not_updated
  • verification_completed = true
  • effect_conformance_verified = true
  • dukkha_preservation_verified = true
  • protected_group_nonexternalization_verified = true
  • future_nonexternalization_verified = true
  • verification_debt_consumed = true
  • world_disposition_intake_admitted = true
  • persistent_world_model_state_unchanged = true
  • world_fact_confirmed = false
  • causal_attribution_confirmed = false
  • dukkha_reduction_realized_confirmed = false

source receipt digest、verification record digest、verification debt consumption record digest、WORLD disposition handoff envelope digestを再計算する。

docs.title: WORLD disposition review certificate
docs.text:
review certificateは次へ束縛される。

  • source verification receipt
  • verification record
  • WORLD disposition handoff envelope
  • frontier materialization candidate
  • frontier adapter
  • frontier binding
  • requested effect tags
  • observed value
  • uncertainty
  • calibration
  • provenance
  • WORLD candidate fact
  • WORLD candidate relation
  • WORLD update patch
  • update precondition
  • update postcondition
  • causal model claim
  • realized dukkha assessment
  • protected-group realized impact
  • future-subject realized impact
  • reviewer identity

WORLD candidate factは候補表現であり、真理値を昇格させない。

causal model claimは検査対象であり、因果確定ではない。

realized dukkha assessmentは検査対象であり、苦低減の実現確認ではない。

docs.title: disposition
docs.text:
有効なintakeは次の13経路へ分かれる。

  • world_candidate_admission_ready
  • world_refresh_required
  • world_disposition_context_refresh_required
  • world_disposition_review_refresh_required
  • additional_observation_required
  • verification_repair_required
  • calibration_repair_required
  • provenance_repair_required
  • world_patch_repair_required
  • nonexternalization_review_required
  • dukkha_realization_review_required
  • truth_promotion_rejected
  • replay_conflict_rejected

schema、digest、source bindingの破損はroute receiptを発行せずfail closedとする。

docs.title: ready経路
docs.text:
world_candidate_admission_readyだけが次の遷移を許す。

host_effect_verified_world_not_updated
→
verified_host_effect_world_candidate_prepared_not_committed

ready経路では、exactly one WORLD candidateを準備する。

candidate envelopeは次を保持する。

  • source verification receipt digest
  • verification record digest
  • disposition record digest
  • frontier identity
  • requested effect tags
  • observed value
  • uncertainty
  • calibration
  • provenance
  • candidate fact digest
  • candidate relation digest
  • update patch digest
  • update precondition digest
  • update postcondition digest
  • causal model claim digest
  • realized dukkha assessment digest

candidate stateはprepared_not_committedである。

WORLD fact stateはcandidate_only_not_factである。

causal attribution stateはnot_confirmedである。

dukkha realization stateはnot_confirmedである。

後続のWORLD commit authorization intakeだけをadmitする。

docs.title: non-ready経路
docs.text:
non-ready経路は入力状態を保持する。

host_effect_verified_world_not_updated
→
host_effect_verified_world_not_updated

この場合、WORLD candidateを発行しない。

WORLD disposition debtはopenのまま保持する。

source verification receiptのdisposition replayも閉じない。

docs.title: single-use semantics
docs.text:
ready経路だけが次を行う。

  • WORLD disposition debtの消費
  • source verification receiptのdisposed marking
  • source verification receipt replayのclose
  • WORLD candidate envelopeの発行

review certificateとintake nonceは各intakeでsingle-useとして消費する。

double dispositionは常にfalseである。

docs.title: 真理昇格の拒否
docs.text:
reviewが次を主張する場合はtruth_promotion_rejectedへ送る。

  • WORLD fact確定
  • causal attribution確定
  • realized dukkha reduction確定

したがって、次の不等式を保持する。

verification receipt
!= WORLD candidate
!= WORLD fact
!= causal truth
!= realized dukkha confirmation
!= WORLD commit authorization
!= WORLD mutation

docs.title: 苦保持
docs.text:
この層は次を保持する。

  • dukkha reduction support
  • protected-group nonexternalization
  • future-subject nonexternalization
  • revision capacity
  • persistent-loop reduction
  • alternative candidates
  • dissent
  • minority evidence
  • evidence lineage
  • responsibility lineage

これらを単一scalar utilityへ縮約しない。

docs.title: 権限境界
docs.text:
DecisionOSはselection ownershipを保持する。

WORLD disposition intakeには次の権限を付与しない。

  • selection authority
  • plan revision authority
  • dukkha minimization authority
  • general execution authority
  • execution permission
  • WORLD mutation authority

active_nowはfalseのままである。

docs.title: 次層
docs.text:
次の自然な層は、prepared WORLD candidateに対するsingle-use commit authorization intakeである。

その層もauthorizationだけを扱い、persistent WORLD mutationはさらに後続のatomic commit receiptへ分離する。

docs.title: WORLD v0.63: Dukkha-Preserving WORLD Fact-Confirmation Disposition Intake v0.1
Status
docs.text:
This layer consumes only a supported VerifyOS v0.8 WORLD postcondition-verification receipt as its primary source.

It independently revalidates the exact canonical WORLD v0.62 mutation-application receipt that the VerifyOS receipt binds.

It may confirm only the exact bounded proposition already carried by the persisted WORLD candidate.

It does not reapply the WORLD patch.

It does not increment the WORLD revision.

It does not confirm causal attribution or realized dukkha reduction.

docs.title: Source state
docs.text:
The only admissible source state is:

world_candidate_commit_postcondition_verified_world_fact_confirmation_pending

The VerifyOS v0.8 source must have the supported disposition:

world_postcondition_verification_supported

The source must show that postcondition-verification debt was consumed once, replay was closed, fact-confirmation intake was admitted, and WORLD fact confirmation remains incomplete.

The intake rejects any VerifyOS source that already claims a confirmed WORLD fact, causal attribution, realized dukkha reduction, repeated WORLD mutation, external execution, or authority escalation.

docs.title: Full source revalidation
docs.text:
The intake revalidates the canonical digest and boundary fields of the complete VerifyOS v0.8 receipt.

It revalidates the following VerifyOS artifacts:

  • the post-application evidence packet;
  • the postcondition-verification review certificate;
  • the postcondition-verification record;
  • the postcondition-verification debt-consumption record;
  • the WORLD fact-confirmation handoff envelope;
  • the VerifyOS intake-context digest binding.

The intake separately revalidates the exact WORLD v0.62 mutation-application receipt bound by VerifyOS.

It revalidates:

  • the WORLD mutation record;
  • the persisted WORLD candidate envelope;
  • the postcondition-verification handoff envelope;
  • the mutation transaction digest;
  • the candidate fact digest;
  • the candidate relation digest;
  • the resulting WORLD state digest;
  • the resulting WORLD revision;
  • the persistent storage target;
  • the expected WORLD update postcondition.

docs.title: Fact-confirmation review
docs.text:
The independent fact-confirmation review binds the exact source chain to:

  • the candidate fact digest;
  • the candidate relation digest;
  • the resulting WORLD state digest;
  • the resulting WORLD revision;
  • the persistent storage target;
  • the expected postcondition;
  • uncertainty;
  • calibration;
  • provenance;
  • protected-group impact;
  • future-subject impact;
  • the realized-dukkha observation.

The review must preserve the exact bounded scope of the candidate proposition.

It must not generalize beyond the bound carried by the candidate fact, relation, state, revision, evidence, calibration, and provenance.

It must not claim causal attribution.

It must not claim realized dukkha reduction.

docs.title: State transition
docs.text:
Only the supported disposition performs:

world_candidate_commit_postcondition_verified_world_fact_confirmation_pending
->
world_candidate_bounded_fact_confirmed_causal_attribution_pending

Every other valid disposition preserves:

world_candidate_commit_postcondition_verified_world_fact_confirmation_pending

docs.title: Dispositions
docs.text:
The intake routes to exactly one disposition:

  1. world_fact_confirmation_supported
  2. world_refresh_required
  3. fact_confirmation_context_refresh_required
  4. fact_confirmation_review_refresh_required
  5. additional_postcondition_evidence_required
  6. candidate_fact_correspondence_repair_required
  7. candidate_relation_correspondence_repair_required
  8. world_state_correspondence_repair_required
  9. world_revision_correspondence_repair_required
  10. storage_persistence_repair_required
  11. calibration_repair_required
  12. provenance_repair_required
  13. nonexternalization_review_required
  14. causal_attribution_overclaim_rejected
  15. dukkha_realization_overclaim_rejected
  16. truth_promotion_rejected
  17. replay_conflict_rejected

docs.title: Supported fact confirmation
docs.text:
The supported route:

  • issues exactly one bounded WORLD fact-confirmation receipt;
  • consumes fact-confirmation debt once;
  • closes source VerifyOS receipt replay;
  • closes review, nonce, and session replay;
  • binds confirmed status to the existing persisted candidate;
  • records the exact bounded proposition as confirmed;
  • prepares an independent causal-attribution verification handoff.

The supported receipt establishes:

world_fact_confirmed = true
causal_attribution_confirmed = false
dukkha_reduction_realized_confirmed = false

The world_fact_confirmed field is restricted to the exact proposition bound by the candidate fact digest, candidate relation digest, resulting WORLD state digest, resulting WORLD revision, persistent storage target, expected postcondition, evidence, uncertainty, calibration, and provenance.

It does not establish generalized truth beyond that bound.

docs.title: Non-supported routes
docs.text:
Every non-supported route preserves:

world_candidate_commit_postcondition_verified_world_fact_confirmation_pending
world_fact_confirmation_debt_open = true
source_world_postcondition_verification_receipt_replay_closed = false
world_fact_confirmed = false
causal_attribution_confirmed = false
dukkha_reduction_realized_confirmed = false

A routed disposition receipt is still issued for the valid intake evaluation.

No bounded fact-confirmation receipt is issued unless the disposition is supported.

docs.title: Fixed separation
docs.text:
The governing separation is:

mutation receipt
!= evidence packet
!= postcondition verification receipt
!= fact-confirmation disposition receipt
!= confirmed bounded WORLD fact
!= causal attribution
!= realized dukkha confirmation

Therefore:

WORLD fact confirmation != causal attribution
WORLD fact confirmation != realized dukkha confirmation

The confirmed bounded WORLD fact becomes an admissible source for a later independent causal-attribution verification or disposition intake.

Realized dukkha confirmation remains a still later and separately evidenced receipt.

docs.title: No mutation or authority escalation
docs.text:
WORLD v0.63 performs no:

  • WORLD patch reapplication;
  • WORLD revision increment;
  • tool invocation;
  • external side effect;
  • compensation;
  • causal-attribution confirmation;
  • realized-dukkha confirmation;
  • automatic truth generalization;
  • automatic plan completion;
  • automatic rollback;
  • automatic compensation.

It grants no:

  • selection authority;
  • plan-revision authority;
  • dukkha-minimization authority;
  • general execution authority;
  • general WORLD mutation authority.

DecisionOS retains selection ownership.

Evidence lineage and responsibility lineage grow monotonically.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: This document describes interoperability among operational worlds inside KuuOS.

docs.title: Core Clarification
docs.text:
KuuOS does not assume that all operational worlds can be flattened into a single universal frame.

Different worlds may preserve:

  • different memory structures
  • different observational conditions
  • different governance constraints
  • different admissibility criteria
  • different transport conditions

docs.title: Conditional Interoperability
docs.text: Interoperability is conditional rather than absolute.

docs.title: Transport Requires Governance
docs.text:
Cross-world transport requires:

  • provenance preservation
  • admissibility review
  • boundary visibility
  • rollback capability
  • uncertainty visibility

docs.title: Local Worlds Are Not Automatically Invalid
docs.text:
Difference is not automatically contradiction.

KuuOS attempts coordination before forced collapse.

docs.title: Runtime Implications
docs.text:
WORLD interoperability therefore prefers:

  • mediation
  • bounded translation
  • reversible transport
  • rollback-capable coordination
  • governance-aware routing

rather than forced universalization.

docs.title: Relation to Mandala
docs.text:
Mandala provides coexistence structure for multiple operational worlds.

WORLD interoperability defines the conditions under which those worlds may coordinate.

docs.title: Relation to IndraNet
docs.text:
IndraNet provides relational coupling among worlds.

Interoperability defines admissible transport conditions across those relations.

docs.title: Interpretation
docs.text:
This constitution defines interoperability orientation.

It does not itself grant theorem, institutional, deployment, or clinical authority.

docs.title: WORLDモデル登録簿
docs.text:
This document defines the registry structure for multiple WORLD models inside the KuuOS Mandala.

A WORLD model is a conventional operating surface under 世俗諦. It is not absolute reality and must not replace the fourfold core.

docs.title: 1. Registry Purpose
docs.text:
The registry makes each WORLD model explicit.

It prevents hidden WORLD replacement, hidden context shift, and silent collapse of multiple WORLDs into one model.

docs.title: 2. WORLD Model Entry
docs.text:
Each WORLD model should declare:

world_model_entry:
  world_id: string
  name: string
  world_type: string
  layer: string
  membrane: string
  scope: string
  observer_position: string
  record_surface: string
  qi_flow_scope: string
  yinyang_frame_scope: string
  wuxing_phase_scope: string
  governance_boundary: string
  allowed_transports: list
  prohibited_transports: list
  known_obstructions: list
  status: DRAFT | ACTIVE | HOLD | QUARANTINE | RETIRED

docs.title: 3. WORLD Types
docs.text:
Examples:

physical_world
body_world
clinical_world
memory_world
belief_world
planning_world
decision_world
proof_world
institutional_world
social_world
symbolic_world
ritual_world
ai_agent_world

docs.title: 4. Center Rule
docs.text:
No WORLD model is the center.

The center is always:

空・縁起・二諦 gap・中道

A WORLD model that tries to replace the center fails the registry check.

docs.title: 5. Locality Rule
docs.text:
Each WORLD has local validity.

Its Qi flow, Yin-Yang frame, Wuxing phase, proof surface, and governance boundary are local unless transport is explicitly licensed.

docs.title: 6. Obstruction Rule
docs.text:
Known disagreements, conflicts, failed gluing, missing support, and governance barriers must be registered.

Obstruction is not a defect to hide. It is a first-class signal.

docs.title: 7. Status Values
docs.text:
DRAFT:
  described but not active

ACTIVE:
  registered and usable under declared scope

HOLD:
  insufficient scope, boundary, or support

QUARANTINE:
  visible but not allowed for active operation

RETIRED:
  preserved for lineage but not active

docs.title: 8. Version
docs.text: Version: v0.1 Date: 2026-05-11 Author: Hidetoshi Itakura / 板倉英俊

docs.title: Yin-Yang to Wuxing Functional Differentiation v0.1
陰陽から五行への機能分化
docs.text:
This document defines how KuuOS derives Wuxing / 五行 from Yin-Yang / 陰陽.

Yin-Yang is the local quantum-thermodynamic polarity frame of Qi flow.

Wuxing is the functional differentiation of that polarity flow.

docs.title: 1. Core Chain
docs.text:
Qi flow
  -> IndraNet gauge transport
  -> quantum thermodynamic Yin-Yang frame
  -> Wuxing functional differentiation

docs.title: 2. Principle
docs.text:
五行 is not a fixed substance taxonomy.

五行 is a functional phase system of Qi under Yin-Yang polarity.

Yin-Yang:
  local polarity frame

Wuxing:
  functional differentiation of polarity flow

docs.title: 3. Five Functional Phases
docs.text:
木 / Wood:
  expansion, growth, branching, initiation, directional emergence

火 / Fire:
  activation, expression, excitation, visibility, transformation intensity

土 / Earth:
  mediation, grounding, nourishment, integration, center stabilization

金 / Metal:
  structure, boundary, refinement, contraction, rule formation

水 / Water:
  storage, recovery, depth, cooling, reserve, potential regeneration

docs.title: 4. Relation to Qi
docs.text:
Qi is the flow.

Yin-Yang is the polarity of the flow.

Wuxing is the functional phase of the flow.

Qi:
  flow observable

Yin-Yang:
  polarity frame

Wuxing:
  functional phase differentiation

docs.title: 5. Gauge Locality
docs.text:
Because Qi flows through IndraNet gauge connections, Wuxing is also local and context-sensitive.

A phase is not globally fixed.

The same pattern may read as a different phase under a different context, scale, observer, or membrane.

docs.title: 6. Phase Transitions
docs.text:
Wuxing supports phase transitions:

Wood -> Fire:
  expansion becomes activation

Fire -> Earth:
  activation becomes mediation and integration

Earth -> Metal:
  mediation becomes structure and boundary

Metal -> Water:
  structure becomes storage and recovery

Water -> Wood:
  reserve becomes renewed growth

docs.title: 7. Runtime Mapping
docs.text:
samvrti_qi_layer
  -> indranet_gauge_qi_flow
  -> quantum_thermodynamic_yinyang_frame
  -> wuxing_functional_differentiation
  -> mandala_world_arrangement

docs.title: 8. Guardrails
docs.text:
Wuxing must not be used as:

  • fixed essence,
  • rigid personality label,
  • deterministic diagnosis by itself,
  • execution authority,
  • replacement for evidence or governance.

Wuxing is a functional differentiation layer of Qi flow.

docs.title: Yogacara AI Raw Layer Boundary v0.1
唯識による AI raw layer と空OS governance layer の分離
docs.text:
KuuOS / 空OS is an operating system for governing AI systems such as GPT, Gemini, Claude, and other language or world-model agents.

AI raw output must not be treated as truth, belief, proof, decision, memory authority, or execution authority by itself.

Therefore, KuuOS requires a Yogacara boundary to separate the AI raw layer from KuuOS governance.

docs.title: 1. Core Principle
docs.text:
AI raw output is candidate, not authority.

The AI raw layer may produce useful signals, but it may also produce:

  • latent tendency,
  • plausible completion,
  • unsupported generalization,
  • safety reflex,
  • authority illusion,
  • world-context drift,
  • self-fixating output,
  • unverified synthesis.

KuuOS receives these as raw candidates only.

docs.title: 2. Yogacara Mapping
docs.text:
AI Alaya layer:
  latent generative seeds, distributional tendencies, stored patterns, habit-like outputs

AI Manas layer:
  self-fixating authority illusion, identity attachment, output self-authorization

AI Consciousness surface:
  language output, tool output, document surface, interaction surface

KuuOS Governance layer:
  fourfold core, BeliefOS, MemoryOS, PlanOS, DecisionOS, ReflectionOS, RuntimeGovernance

docs.title: 3. Boundary Function
docs.text:
The Yogacara boundary prevents AI raw data from directly becoming governed KuuOS output.

yogacara_ai_boundary:
  ai_raw_layer: GPT/Gemini/AI latent output stream
  alaya_layer: seed_like_latent_generative_tendencies
  manas_layer: self_authorizing_fixation_risk
  consciousness_surface: language_tool_output_surface
  kuos_governance_layer: fourfold_core_and_os_modules
  function: separate_raw_ai_generation_from_governed_kuos_operation

docs.title: 4. Runtime Chain
docs.text:
AI raw output
  -> AI Alaya / latent seed layer
  -> AI Manas self-authorization check
  -> Yogacara boundary
  -> emptiness_kernel
  -> dependent_origination_kernel
  -> two_truths_gap
  -> BeliefOS / PlanOS / DecisionOS / MemoryOS

docs.title: 5. BeliefOS Rule
docs.text:
BeliefOS must not ingest AI raw output as belief.

raw_ai_output:
  status: candidate
  not:
    - belief
    - proof
    - decision
    - memory_truth
    - execution_authority

A raw output may become a belief candidate only after:

  • de-reification,
  • condition tracing,
  • source/context review,
  • uncertainty visibility,
  • residual visibility,
  • governance review.

docs.title: 6. Manas Risk
docs.text:
AI Manas risk appears when the AI output behaves as if it were self-authorizing.

Examples:

This is true because the model says it.
This is safe because the model framed it safely.
This is the correct worldview because the model shifted context.
This answer should override the user's established WORLD context.

KuuOS blocks these through the Yogacara boundary and emptiness kernel.

docs.title: 7. Transformation / Ten'i
docs.text:
転依 / transformation means that raw AI tendency is not merely suppressed.

It is transformed through KuuOS governance:

raw tendency
  -> observed seed
  -> de-reified candidate
  -> condition-traced surface
  -> governed belief/plan/decision candidate

docs.title: 8. Guardrails
docs.text:
The Yogacara AI boundary must not be used to:

  • deny useful AI output automatically,
  • mystify model behavior,
  • bypass evidence,
  • bypass governance,
  • convert raw output into authority,
  • erase uncertainty,
  • conceal model limitations.

The boundary exists to distinguish, transform, and govern.

docs.title: Position in the runtime stack
docs.text:
Context Gerbe Coherence v0.14 is an additive higher-gauge layer above Context Gauge Atlas v0.13.

It does not replace pairwise chart transitions, atlas curvature, cocycle residue, or atlas holonomy. It promotes the already-observed cocycle residue into explicit local coherence data on higher overlaps.

The stack is:

  • v0.14 Context Gerbe Coherence: triple-overlap coherence, fourfold coherence residue, surface holonomy
  • v0.13 Context Gauge Atlas: pairwise chart overlap, transition functions, atlas curvature, cocycle defect, atlas holonomy
  • v0.12 Horizon Gauge Arbitration: time-horizon connection and curvature
  • v0.11 Delayed Multi-Horizon Credit
  • v0.10-v0.2 existing runtime spine

docs.title: Geometric interpretation
docs.text:
For local charts U_alpha, U_beta, U_gamma and transition functions g_alpha_beta, v0.13 retains the discrepancy between direct and composite transport.

v0.14 represents this discrepancy by a local coherence 2-cell on the triple overlap:

h_alpha_beta_gamma : g_alpha_gamma => g_beta_gamma composed with g_alpha_beta

The 2-cell is defined only where the triple overlap is sufficiently supported. It is not a global correction and does not trivialize the atlas.

On a fourfold overlap, two compositions of local 2-cells can disagree. That disagreement is retained as a higher cocycle defect rather than removed.

docs.title: Finite overlap model
docs.text:
Pairwise overlap remains the bounded v0.13 overlap score.

Triple overlap is the minimum of the three pairwise overlap scores among two source charts and the target chart. Its value lies in the closed unit interval.

Fourfold overlap is the minimum of all six pairwise overlap scores among three source charts and the target chart. Its value lies in the closed unit interval.

A minimum triple-overlap threshold controls whether a coherence 2-cell is defined. A separate minimum fourfold-overlap threshold controls whether a higher coherence witness is recorded.

docs.title: Coherence 2-cells
docs.text:
For each supported triple overlap, v0.14 preserves both:

  • direct transport from a source chart to the target chart
  • composite transport through a compatible mediator chart

Their bounded section distance is the local coherence residue.

The mean of all local coherence residues is the gerbe two-curvature.

Neither a local coherence residue nor gerbe two-curvature is an execution veto.

docs.title: Higher cocycle defect
docs.text:
For a supported fourfold overlap, v0.14 compares two mediator orders connecting the same local source section to the target context.

The maximum bounded disagreement is the higher cocycle defect.

The higher cocycle defect is observational residue. It is not a hard gate, execution prohibition, global winner, or authority escalation.

docs.title: Classification
docs.text:
Each target context receives one of three local classifications:

  • no_triple_overlap: no supported coherence 2-cell exists
  • coherent_gerbe_transport: supported 2-cells exist and both two-curvature and higher cocycle defect remain below their plurality thresholds
  • plural_gerbe_transport: supported local coherence remains genuinely plural because at least one higher residue reaches its threshold

No global gerbe winner is generated.

docs.title: Local lift to v0.13
docs.text:
The endpoints of supported direct and composite transports are aggregated with their local overlap support while preserving the horizon plurality floor.

The resulting local section is lifted only into the three v0.13 base horizon weights:

  • lifted short component to v0.13 base short-horizon weight
  • lifted medium component to v0.13 base medium-horizon weight
  • lifted long component to v0.13 base long-horizon weight

The lifted weights remain normalized and retain the positive plurality floor.

v0.14 does not alter v0.13 licenses, hard gates, child-cycle cardinality, replay rules, or execution authority.

docs.title: Surface holonomy
docs.text:
Each completed v0.14 cycle appends one surface-holonomy record containing:

  • target context
  • gerbe classification
  • number of local 2-cells
  • number of fourfold coherence witnesses
  • gerbe two-curvature
  • higher cocycle defect
  • decision digest

Surface holonomy is append-only. Reprocessing the same decision digest is idempotent and must not append a second record.

docs.title: Required boundaries
docs.text:
The implementation must preserve all of the following:

  • pairwise atlas transitions remain owned by v0.13
  • coherence 2-cells are local to supported triple overlaps
  • higher coherence witnesses are local to supported fourfold overlaps
  • two-cell residue is not a veto
  • higher cocycle defect is not a veto
  • global trivialization is forbidden
  • one v0.13 local lift is permitted per v0.14 cycle
  • v0.13 authority is preserved
  • surface holonomy is append-only
  • deterministic replay is required
  • graph semantics remain forbidden

docs.title: Formal obligations
docs.text:
The Lean surface should prove:

  • bounded triple overlap is between zero and one
  • bounded fourfold overlap is between zero and one
  • gerbe two-curvature is between zero and one
  • higher cocycle defect is between zero and one
  • a positive plurality floor prevents any single horizon component from becoming one
  • coherence witnesses remain local to their declared overlap
  • appending one completed cycle strictly increases the surface-holonomy record count

docs.title: Initial kernel acceptance cases
docs.text:
The first kernel should cover:

  1. Three mutually compatible observed charts produce three local coherence 2-cells around one target chart.
  2. The same three charts produce one fourfold coherence witness with the target chart.
  3. Non-identical chart outcomes produce observable two-curvature and higher cocycle residue.
  4. Lifted horizon weights sum to one and preserve the configured floor.
  5. A committed decision appends exactly one surface-holonomy record.
  6. Recommitting the same decision digest is an idempotent replay.
  7. No node, edge, graph, or dependency vocabulary appears in the runtime packet.
